abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent robot hand for picking detection of spherical fruits and vegetables and a mechanical arm system. The intelligent robot hand comprises an upper mounting frame, alower mounting frame, a clamping mechanism and a near infrared spectrum detection module, wherein the upper mounting frame is a hollow cylinder with an opening in the side wall; the lower mounting frame is a hollow cylinder, and part of the side wall of the hollow cylinder is cut off; the near infrared spectrum detection module comprises an optical sensor, a light shield, a light source and a microswitch; and the clamping mechanism comprises two racks, a gear, two sliding blocks, a linear guide rail, a finger connecting piece I, a finger connecting piece II and two soft rubber fingers. The mechanical arm system comprises the intelligent robot hand, and further comprises a mechanical arm, a mechanical arm controller, an upper computer, a single-chip microcomputer and a binocular camera. According to the intelligent robot hand and the mechanical arm system, the response is rapid and sensitive when the fruits and vegetables are grabbed and released, and the surfaces of the fruits and vegetables cannot be damaged. The picking-detection-graded packing operation can be accurately and rapidly completed, and the intelligent robot hand and the mechanical arm system have the characteristicsof high efficiency, portability, compact structure, good universality, accurate result, multi-index detection and the like.
source_title: Intelligent robot hand for picking detection of spherical fruits and vegetables and mechanical arm system

abstract: The invention discloses a manipulator grabbing posture generation method and device, a sample construction method and device, equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of dexterous hand control. By inputting the obtained point cloud data of the to-be-grasped object set into the target grasping posture generation model, the target grasping posture data corresponding to the to-be-grasped object set can be quickly output, the whole process takes several seconds or even within ten seconds, and the method for quickly generating the grasping posture can be applied to a real-time robot system. Furthermore, according to the target grabbing posture data, the manipulator can grab a plurality of objects, and the capacity of the manipulator for stably grabbing the plurality of objects is improved.
source_title: Manipulator grabbing posture generation method and device, sample construction method and device, equipment and medium

abstract: The objective of the present invention is to provide a gripping attitude evaluating device capable of evaluating an appropriate gripping attitude of a target object, taking into account a load on a robot. A gripping attitude evaluating device (10) includes a gripping attitude deriving unit (101) for deriving a gripping attitude of a robot hand H when the robot hand H, with which a robot RB is provided, grips a workpiece, a load index value calculating unit (103) for calculating a load index value representing a load acting on the robot RB if the robot hand H grips and conveys the workpiece in accordance with the gripping attitude derived by the gripping attitude deriving unit (101), and a gripping attitude evaluating unit (104) for evaluating whether the gripping attitude is appropriate, on the basis of the load index value calculated by the load index value calculating unit (103), wherein, each time the gripping attitude evaluating unit (104) evaluates that the gripping attitude is not appropriate, derivation of a new gripping attitude by the gripping attitude deriving unit (101), calculation of the load index value by the load index value calculating unit (103), and evaluation by the gripping attitude evaluating unit (104) are repeated.
source_title: GRIPPING ATTITUDE EVALUATING DEVICE, AND GRIPPING ATTITUDE EVALUATING PROGRAM

abstract: A sensor tip (10) for use in a robotic hand has a three-dimensional compliant elastomeric body (12) with an outer boundary (22) having a circular base (24) and a convex surface (26) extending therefrom. Four strain transducers (14, 16, 18, and 20) produce electrical signals indicative of the strain at various positions near the boundary of the elastomeric body (12) resulting from forces exerted upon the sensor tip (10) by an object which the robotic hand is manipulating. The transducers (14, 16, 18, and 20) are positioned about the convex surface (26) so as to produce signals that may be decoupled to determine the normal and tangential forces and the applied torque. A buffer amplifier circuit (34), one for each of the transducers (14, 16, 18, and 20), receives the signals and provides quasi-steady state force information. The circuit (34) connects the respective transducer (40) in a feedback loop around an amplifier (36) and has desirable attributes for static charge buffering. The sensor tip (10) is calibrated to determine proportionality constants for the decoupling algorithm for use of a force delivering system (60), which uses voice coils (74) to apply a force that is linearly related to the current introduced to each of the coils (74). A method of manufacture of the sensor tip (10) results in improved bonding between the transducers (14, 16, 18, and 20) and the elastomeric body (12) for better performance and longer life of the sensor tip (10). <IMAGE>
source_title: SENSOR TIP FOR A ROBOTIC GRIPPER AND METHOD OF MANUFACTURE

abstract: A robot hand module includes a palm part and a thumb module coupled to the palm part, wherein the thumb module includes a thumb phalangeal part movably coupled to the palm part, a thumb cable part having a first side connected to the thumb phalangeal part, and a thumb driving part connected to a second side of the thumb cable part and configured to operate the thumb phalangeal part by extending the thumb cable part to the outside or retracting the thumb cable part, and wherein the thumb phalangeal part includes a thumb pre-tensioner configured to pull the thumb cable part, a first side of the thumb pre-tensioner being fixed relative to the thumb phalangeal part, and a second side of the thumb pre-tensioner being fixed to the thumb cable part.
source_title: Robot hand module

abstract: A robotic hand includes an interior casing, a cladding layer wrapped around an end of the interior casing, a plurality of photoelectric sensors, and a controller. The photoelectric sensors are located at different locations on an exterior surface of the interior casing, and are wrapped by the cladding layer. The photoelectric sensors can sense light signals striking different locations on the exterior surface of the interior casing, and convert the sensed optical signals into electrical signals. The controller can obtain the generated electrical signals, determine a pressure value applied according to the obtained electric signals, and generate a control signal according to the determined pressure value causing the robot to generate feedback.
source_title: Robotic hand, method for making the same, and robot having the same

abstract: Processe and system for preparing a vehicle surface (e.g., an aircraft fuselage) for painting include a preparation booth (100) which is sized and configured to house the vehicle (F). At least one robotic assembly (200a, 200b) is reciprocally movable within the preparation booth (100) relative to a longitudinal axis of the vehicle (F), and is provided with a robotic hand (230) having at least one abrasive disc (242a) attached to an attachment pad (242) of the robotic hand (230), and at least one nozzle (252a, 252b, 252c) for discharging a stream of rinse fluid. Operation of the at least one robotic assembly (230) will cause the at least one abrasive disc (242a) of the robot hand (230) to abrade the surface of the vehicle (F). The robotic hand (230) may thereafter be maneuvered so that the at least one nozzle (252a, 252b, 252c) is directed toward the abraded vehicle surface (F). A stream of rinse fluid may then be discharged through the at least one nozzle (252a, 252b, 252c) and towards the abraded surface of the vehicle (F) so as to rinse the abraded surface of particulate matter.
source_title: AUTOMATED SYSTEMS AND PROCESSES FOR PREPARING VEHICLE SURFACES, SUCH AS AN AIRCRAFT FUSELAGE, FOR PAINTING

abstract: A robot hand and a robot having the robot hand, the robot hand having a mechanism configured to appropriately carry out surface matching between an electrical magnet and an adsorbed surface of a workpiece, corresponding to the posture of the adsorbed surface. The robot hand has: a hand base; a holder attached to the hand base; a spherical bearing arranged in the holder so that a rotational center of the spherical bearing is positioned on a hand center axis; a connecting member attached to the holder via the spherical bearing, the connecting member having a protruding portion which protrudes from the holder in a direction opposed to the hand base; a holder base fixed to an attachment surface opposed to an adsorbing surface of the electrical magnet; and a posture restoring member for restoring the posture of the holder base so that the holder base represents a neutral posture.
source_title: ROBOT AND ROBOT HAND HAVING SURFACE MATCHING FUNCTION

abstract: The invention discloses a universal robot dexterous hand grabbing teaching device and a grabbing strategy learning method. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-modal data; establishing an SLAM model, carrying out real-time pose calculation on the multi-modal data, and returning the multi-modal data in the SLAM model in real time in combination with the action of the dexterous hand; the method comprises the following steps: constructing a learning network comprising a visual encoder ViT, a multi-head cross attention mechanism, a force perception encoder MLP, a splicing module and a Diffusion Policy; training a learning model; generating an action conforming to a target; obtaining delay compensation data; obtaining an updated robot action generation strategy; and predicting a subsequent action sequence in real time. The device comprises an IMU camera, a paper mirror, a fixing device, a touch sensor and a computer program product. According to the teaching device and the grabbing strategy learning method, the teaching device and the grabbing strategy learning method can be suitable for various different robot platforms, and execution of various complex tasks such as operation tasks in the fields of industrial automation, family service, medical care and the like is achieved through imitation learning.
source_title: Universal robot dexterous hand grabbing teaching device and grabbing strategy learning method

abstract: The invention provides a robot hand and a robot device. A robot hand (50) is provided with a plurality of fingers (33), a first electromagnet (512), a second electromagnet (522), and a movable part (53) capable of moving between the first electromagnet (512) and the second electromagnet (522). Each of the plurality of fingers (33) has: a gripping section (331) that grips the object (M); and a cam follower (332) that rotates about a rotation shaft (333) in conjunction with the movement of the movable part (53).
source_title: Robot hand and robot device

abstract: The invention provides a multi-finger flexible hand of a robot based on a pneumatic flexible driver, which comprises five fingers and a palm, wherein five finger mounting seats are arranged inside the palm; the five fingers are a thumb, a forefinger, a middle finger, a ring finger and a little finger respectively; a bent joint comprises the pneumatic flexible driver, a hinge rotary pair and two positioning plates; two sides of the hinge rotary pair are fixedly connected with the positioning plates; a front end closure and a rear end closure of the pneumatic flexible driver are fixedly connected with the two positioning plates; a side-sway joint comprises two pneumatic flexible drivers and an axial telescopic hinge; the axial telescopic hinge is a telescopic rotary pair formed by two movable components through a gain structure; the movable components are connected with front end closures and rear end closures of the pneumatic flexible drivers; and axial lines of the two pneumatic flexible drivers are parallel and vertical to the axial line of a hinge pin roll. The multi-finger flexible hand has the advantages of simple structure, good flexibility and good applicability.
source_title: Multi-finger dexterous hand of robot based on pneumatic flexible driver

abstract: The invention relates to a three-dimensional coupler mechanism which can be expanded in modular fashion and is intended for the telescopic guidance of a driven member. By means of said coupler mechanism, the collision area of special robots and robot hand joints is reduced, along with the simultaneous increase in movability. By the exclusive use of rotary joints, a simple, comparatively play-free construction is possible. Figure 1 shows the arrangement described. <IMAGE>
source_title: Telescopic folding structure

abstract: The information processing device according to one example of the present disclosure comprises a simulation processing unit that executes a dynamic simulation of a grasping operation that includes the interactions of a robot hand and a grasped object on the basis of structural data about the structure of the robot hand and behavioral data about the movement of the robot hand during the grasping operation. The simulation processing unit executes the dynamic simulation of the grasping operation under conditions in which a disturbance is applied.
source_title: INFORMATION PROCESSING DEVICE

abstract: The invention provides a seat robot and relates to the technical field of a seat. The seat robot comprises a seat cushion part, a back cushion part, a headrest part, handrails, a supporting pedestal and robot hands; the seat cushion part is connected with the back cushion part; the headrest is arranged at the upper end of the back cushion part; the two handrails are arranged on the two sides of the seat cushion part and comprise a left handrail and a right handrail; the robot hands are arranged on the two sides of the back cushion part and comprise a left robot hand and a right robot hand; andthe supporting pedestal is arranged below the seat cushion part. The seat robot has the following beneficial effects: people can use the seat robot to massage and listen to music and also can operateand control the robot hands to pour tea, so that body burden caused by long-time work of people is reduced and the comfort level of people is increased.
source_title: Seat robot

abstract: A robot hand apparatus includes a base, three finger mechanisms, a thumb mechanism, and three motors for the three finger mechanisms. The base corresponds to a part of the hand of a human, i.e. a palm and dorsum of a human. Each of three finger mechanisms is elongated in almost the same direction from the end of the base and is adapted to be actuated by the motor. The thumb mechanism is elongated from the different portion from the base. The thumb mechanism and the finger mechanism close to the thumb mechanism are configured to define a U-shape space.
source_title: ROBOT HAND APPARATUS AND ROBOT ARM FOR SAME

abstract: The invention discloses a manipulator, a robot hand, a robot control method, a control system and a computer readable storage medium. The control method comprises the steps of determining a target task of the manipulator; according to the target task, determining activity parameters of each finger part; the activity parameters comprise a rotation angle; and controlling the finger to move according to the activity parameters of the finger so as to execute the target task. Due to the fact that the rotation modes of the first finger part and the second finger part are different, and the first finger part and the second finger part both have two different rotation modes, the flexibility of the mechanical arm is high. The target task of the manipulator is determined, then the activity parameters of the finger parts are determined according to the target task, and then the finger parts are controlled to move according to the activity parameters of the finger parts so as to execute or complete the target task. Rotation of the first finger part and the second finger part is accurately controlled through the movement parameters of all the finger parts, so that the flexibility of the manipulator is high, and the control accuracy is high.
source_title: Manipulator, robot hand, robot control method, control system and computer readable storage medium

abstract: The invention provides a robot hand-eye calibration method and a storage medium. The robot hand-eye calibration method comprises the following steps that a robot and a depth camera are arranged, an actuator is connected to the tail end of the robot, and a calibration mark is arranged on the actuator; the depth camera is aligning the calibration mark disposed on the actuator; a robot base coordinate system is established at the bottom surface of the starting end of the robot, and a TCP coordinate system is established at the tail end of the robot; a pose of the robot is changed so that the calibration mark is within the field of view of the depth camera; a pose of the TCP coordinate system is acquired in the robot base coordinate system; a two-dimensional image and a depth image of the depth camera are acquired, the center of the calibration mark is positioned in the two-dimensional image, and a three-dimensional coordinate of the center in a camera coordinate system are acquired in thedepth image; at least five sets of three-dimensional coordinates and poses are acquired; and according to the acquired three-dimensional coordinates and the pose, a linear equation set of the three-dimensional coordinates of the center from the camera coordinate system to the robot base coordinate system is determined, solution is solved in iterative algorithm, and the calibration of the hand-eyerelationship between the robot and the depth camera is realized.
source_title: Robot hand-eye calibration method and storage medium

abstract: A robot hand apparatus (1) includes four of finger mechanisms (20) each elongates from a base(10), a motor (30) actuating each finger mechanism (20), four of rotation rollers (50) each connects with corresponding finger mechanism (20) for actuating each finger mechanism (20), and a power transmission mechanism (60) transmitting a power from the motor (30) to each rotation roller (50) at different timing.
source_title: ROBOT HAND DEVICE

abstract: The invention provides a progressive motion-power alignment smart operation rapid migration method and system. Relates to the technical field of robot operation control. The method comprises the following steps: extracting hand-object movement and interaction information from an RGB hand-object interaction video; based on kinematics matching, mapping the hand operation track into a primary control signal of the target dexterous hand; performing dynamic optimization on the primary control signal in combination with a multi-level reward mechanism under a reinforcement learning framework, and generating a stable grabbing control strategy; a dexterous wrist control signal is synthesized according to the object target trajectory, and the semantic consistency of operation tasks is kept; and through a multi-dexterous-hand configuration adaptation mechanism, a control signal is migrated to dexterous hands of different configurations. According to the method, the human hand operation track can be automatically converted into control instructions of multiple types of dexterous hands, so that the dexterous hands have the capability of executing complex tasks such as grabbing, moving and operation, the training data acquisition cost of the dexterous hands is reduced, and the cross-equipment operation reusability and generalization capability are improved.
source_title: Progressive motion-power alignment smart operation rapid migration method and system

abstract: The invention discloses a pneumatic type soft mechanical hand with a touch sensing function. The pneumatic soft mechanical hand is composed of an electric heating phase change actuator, a soft mechanical hand and a flexible touch sensing unit, wherein a flexible heating film and a liquid phase change material are arranged in the electric heating phase change actuator. According to the pneumatic type soft mechanical hand with the touch sensing function, the liquid phase change material is evaporated by electrifying and heating the flexible heating film, so that the pressure intensity of the cavity in the inner part of the electric heating phase change actuator is regulated, thus the bending state of the soft mechanical hand is dynamically adjusted so as to complete the grabbing operation; meanwhile, the flexible touch sensing unit is used for sensing time-varying information of grabbing force during the grabbing target process of the soft mechanical hand and taking the time-varying information as a feedback source for adjusting the bending state of the soft mechanical hand, so that closed-loop feedback control is formed; and the structure of the pneumatic type soft mechanical hand is flexible, a feasibility scheme is provided for safely and intelligently grabbing for the robot dexterous hand.
source_title: Pneumatic soft mechanical hand with touch sensing function

abstract: PURPOSE: A robot hand is provided to realize an instant palletizing of products having a producing cycle time of 3-5 seconds through loading 2-4 products in once or twice. CONSTITUTION: By hanging a hook adapter(44) to a hook base adapter(45) and elevating a hook locker(43), a finger assay unit is combined to a hook base plate(32) by a hook locker fixing bolt(47). The hook adapter is mounted while being hung to the hook base adapter for supporting rotation moment. Then, products are lifted and transferred by fingers(38) of the finger assay unit. In case of hitting a material in lowering a robot hand, a hook arm(42) is slid up by the hook locker. Then, the hook adapter is elevated for an approaching sensor(36) on a front surface of the hook base plate to detect a sensor detect plate(52) on the hook adapter. Herein, the detected signal is processed as a collision signal.
source_title: DEFORMABLE AND DEVIDED LOADING TYPE ROBOT HAND

abstract: This robot hand comprises a movable part, a hand that deforms in accordance with the movement of the movable part, and an elastic body that varies the gripping force of the hand. When the amount by which the movable part has moved is less than a prescribed value, at least the hand deforms. When the amount by which the movable part has moved is equal to or greater than the prescribed value, the elastic force of the elastic body changes in a state in which deformation of at least part of the hand has stopped.
source_title: ROBOT HAND

abstract: A robotic hand is provided with an array of movable spring loaded fingers and an assembly opposed to the fingers. An object to be grasped by the hand is pushed by the assembly toward and into contact with the fingers. An electrical signal is produced when each finger is contacted by the object. The time intervals between various finger contacts are measured and used to calculate the distance that the object moved during those intervals. These distances provide information about the shape of the object which can be used to differentiate between objects of various shapes.
source_title: Robot hand

abstract: In a compliance apparatus wherein a movable plate movable in a direction perpendicular to the direction of insertion of a gripped part is provided on a portion in which a robot hand is mounted to a robot arm to thereby enable relative displacement of the robot hand and the robot arm, a plurality of cylinders of which the extended end positions are adjustable and of which the protruding force can be changed by a spring or fluid are opposed to one another as positioning devices for the movable plate and sandwich the movable plate therebetween.
source_title: COMPLIANCE DEVICE FOR ROBOT HAND

abstract: The invention provides a flexible holder based on a novel two-finger robot hand. An upper end cross arm of the flexible holder is installed on a vertical guide rail mechanism in a liftable mode; two pneumatic clamps are installed at the bottoms of the two ends of the upper end cross arm in parallel at an interval; two lower end cross arms are respectively fixed to the same side wall of the lower end of the vertical guide rail mechanism in parallel at an interval; two two-finger robot hands are movably installed on the lower end cross arms in the axial direction of the lower end cross arms correspondingly, and the moving direction is the same as the length extension direction of the lower ends of the vertical guide rail mechanisms; a driver is fixedly installed at the middle of the side wall of the lower end of the vertical guide rail mechanism and located between the two two-finger robot hands; and driving ends at the two ends of the driver are in transmission connection with the two two-finger robot hands correspondingly and are used for driving the two two-finger robot hands to move on the lower end cross arms correspondingly. The flexible holder is simple in structure, convenient to use and high in working efficiency.
source_title: Flexible holder based on novel two-finger robot hand

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom full-drive dexterous hand and a robot, the multi-degree-of-freedom full-drive dexterous hand comprises a palm and a plurality of fingers, the plurality of fingers are arranged on the palm at intervals, and the fingers comprise a proximal knuckle finger, a middle knuckle finger, a distal knuckle finger, a first motor, a second motor, a third motor and a fourth motor; wherein each of the first motor, the second motor, the third motor and the fourth motor is a frameless torque motor and is used for driving the fingers to bend or stretch so as to grab or release an object. By means of the direct driving mode, the movement of the finger joints is more direct and sensitive, finer and more complex actions can be achieved, and the flexibility of the fingers is greatly improved. Meanwhile, the space occupied by the driving structure is reduced, so that the internal structure of the bionic hand is simpler, more space is provided for layout of all parts of the fingers, and improvement of the overall compactness and miniaturization degree of the bionic hand is facilitated.
source_title: Multi-degree-of-freedom full-drive dexterous hand and robot

abstract: This robot hand for retaining a substrate is characterized in that: provided are a base body, a blade which has a prescribed retention position for retaining a substrate and a basal section of which is attached to the base body, and a differential screw, the central axis of which is orthogonal to a principal surface of the substrate in the retention position and which is used for attaching the basal section of the blade to the base body; the differential screw comprises a first screw section, the pitch of which is a first pitch, a second screw section, the pitch of which is a second pitch that is different from the first pitch, a third screw section that screws together with the first screw section, and an interposed member that coaxially has a fourth screw section that screws together with the second screw section; and the first screw section is disposed in the base body and the second screw section is disposed in the basal section of the blade.
source_title: ROBOT HAND, ROBOT, AND SECURING DEVICE

abstract: A robotic hand (1) is provided, which comprises a palm (2); a plurality of phalanges (3a, 3b) adapted to reproduce a plurality of fingers; hinges (4), each of which hinging a first element identifying a phalanx (3a, 3b) to a second element identifying one among the palm (2) and a phalanx (3a, 3b); and an actuating mechanism (5) comprising at least a first pulley (51) located at each hinge (4) and bound to the first element; second pulleys (52) located at each of the hinges (4) and bound to the second element; a single cable (53) running in all of the pulleys; and a motor (54) adapted to act on the cable by controlling the rotation of the phalanges.
source_title: UNDERACTUATED ROBOTIC HAND

abstract: This robot hand system comprises: a robot hand having one or more holding units for holding an object 8 to be held, a drive unit for moving the holding unit, an encoder for detecting a moving distance of the holding unit, and a sensor capable of detecting a magnet arranged around the holding unit and a positional change with respect to the magnet; and a control device for controlling the drive unit on the basis of outputs of the sensor and the encoder. One of the magnet and the sensor is arranged so as to be able to move in accordance with the movement of the holding unit.
source_title: ROBOT HAND SYSTEM, CONTROL METHOD, ROBOT HAND, AND CONTROL DEVICE

abstract: The invention discloses a dexterous hand for grabbing irregular objects, and relates to the technical field of soft robots, the dexterous hand comprises a mounting bracket, an adjusting mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the mounting bracket, an adsorption mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the mounting bracket, the adjusting mechanism comprises a rotary adjusting unit, and the rotary adjusting unit is arranged on the outer side of the mounting bracket. The adjusting mechanism comprises a rotating adjusting unit and a bending adjusting unit, the rotating adjusting unit can conveniently rotate and adjust the position of the thumb, the bending adjusting unit is arranged above the installation support, the bending adjusting unit is used in cooperation with the rotating adjusting unit, and the bending adjusting unit can conveniently adjust the bending state of the four fingers. According to the dexterous hand for grabbing the irregular objects, by arranging the rotation adjusting unit, the bending adjusting unit and the adsorption mechanism, the problem that when the dexterous hand is used, the posture of the dexterous hand cannot be adjusted, and consequently the irregular objects cannot be taken is solved.
source_title: Dexterous hand for grabbing irregular objects

abstract: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a robot control system and robot control method capable of placing a part held by a robot hand at the correct location on another member. A robot control system (1) is provided with: a robot hand (12) for grasping a clip (31); a camera (3) for taking an image of the clip (31) held by the robot hand (12); a calculation unit (16) for calculating the position of the clip (31) or the inclination of a part on the basis of the clip (31)-imaging results taken by the camera (3); and a robot control unit (17) for controlling the robot hand (12) so as to
source_title: ROBOT CONTROL SYSTEM AND ROBOT CONTROL METHOD

abstract: The invention provides a GRU-based social robot hand motion control method and system in the technical field of social robots. The method comprises the steps of S1, collecting a large amount of historical motion interaction data to construct a data set; s2, creating a control instruction generation model, and setting a loss function of the control instruction generation model; s3, training the control instruction generation model through the data set and the loss function, and deploying the trained control instruction generation model to the social robot; s4, the social robot collects environment sensing data in real time, the environment sensing data is input into the deployed control instruction generation model, and a hand motion control instruction is obtained; and S5, the social robot converts the hand motion control instruction into a motor parameter through a nonlinear normalization algorithm, and controls the hand to move based on the motor parameter. The method has the advantages that the precision, the adaptability and the robustness of the hand motion control of the social robot are greatly improved.
source_title: GRU-based social robot hand motion control method and system

abstract: A control apparatus makes a robot hand grip a work for measurement. The control apparatus controls the operation of a robot arm so that the robot arm keeps a force of striking the work for measurement against a reference constant, while making the end portion of the robot arm rotate around the end axis, in a state of making the outer periphery F3 of the work for measurement, which is gripped by the robot hand, strike against the reference jig. The control apparatus acquires a detection result detected by an encoder of each of the joints when the end portion of the robot arm has been rotated. The control apparatus calculates a correction amount of trajectory data based on eccentricity of a central axis with respect to an end axis, by using the detection result of the encoder, and corrects the trajectory data, based on the correction amount.
source_title: ROBOT CONTROLLING METHOD, ROBOT APPARATUS, PROGRAM AND RECORDING MEDIUM

abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a dexterous hand based on a speed reducer and a difference mechanism. A plurality of motor-speed reducer combinations are reasonably distributed, two motor-speed reducer combinations are combined with a difference mechanism to achieve the pitching degree of freedom and the yawing degree of freedom of the finger root joint, one motor-speed reducer combination is used for driving the bending and stretching degree of freedom of the middle-end joint, and therefore the degree of freedom is high while the degree of freedom is achieved. And the number of driving devices is obviously reduced. And moreover, the fingers are driven by a motor-speed reducer combination, the speed reducer of a duplex planetary gear structure is adopted, and the design of specific tooth number is combined, so that torque output is effectively optimized, and the compact structure is realized on the premise of ensuring high gripping power of the dexterous hand.
source_title: Dexterous hand based on speed reducer and difference mechanism

abstract: An improved robotic thumb for a robotic hand assembly is provided. According to one aspect of the disclosure, improved tendon routing in the robotic thumb provides control of four degrees of freedom with only five tendons. According to another aspect of the disclosure, one of the five degrees of freedom of a human thumb is replaced in the robotic thumb with a permanent twist in the shape of a phalange. According to yet another aspect of the disclosure, a position sensor includes a magnet having two portions shaped as circle segments with different center points. The magnet provides a linearized output from a Hall effect sensor.
source_title: Robotic thumb assembly

abstract: The clamp attaching device is provided with: a robot arm base (20) having a rotary table; a robot arm disposed on the rotary table of the robot arm base (20) and having multiple arms (21, 22, 23, 24, 25) and multiple joints; a robot hand (15) attached to the foremost arm (25) among the multiple arms (21, 22, 23, 24, 25); and a control unit. The robot hand (15) is provided with: a clamp gripping unit (16) for gripping a clamp (50); a fastening unit (17) for fastening a screw part of the clamp (50) so as to apply an elastic clamping force to a workpiece (80); and a measurement unit (18, 19) for collecting position data of a predetermined member of the clamp (50). The clamp can be automatically attached and detached, and thermal curing and the like can be carried out with the clamp attached.
source_title: CLAMP ATTACHING DEVICE, CLAMP ATTACHING SYSTEM, AND CLAMP ATTACHING METHOD

abstract: The invention relates to a robot arm (2) with a robot-hand drive device (11), which has at least three electric motors (M4, M5, M6) arranged in an arm boom (6) of the robot arm (2) for driving a multi-axis robot hand (7) of the arm boom (6), each electric motor (M4, M5, M6) having an electric rotor (M4.1, M5.1, M6.1), each of which has a motor shaft (M4.2, M5.2, M6.2). The at least three electric motors (M4, M5, M6) are arranged in the interior of a common housing cylinder block (12), in such a way that each rotor (M4.1, M5.1, M6.1) lies in a separate cylinder sector of the housing cylinder block (12), more specifically with its respective motor shaft M4.2, M5.2, M6.2) running parallel to the centre axis (Z) of the housing cylinder block (12), said axis running longitudinally along the arm boom (6).
source_title: ROBOT ARM WITH A ROBOT-HAND DRIVE DEVICE

abstract: The invention provides a robot hand-eye calibration method and device, electronic equipment and a system. The method comprises the steps that three-dimensional point cloud image information obtained through photographing of a three-dimensional camera is obtained, wherein the three-dimensional point cloud image information comprises three-dimensional point cloud information of at least three identification balls which are not completely located on the same straight line; first position data of the mass center of the identification balls in a camera coordinate system are calculated according tothe three-dimensional point cloud image information; second position data of the mass center of the identification balls in a robot base coordinate system are acquired; and a conversion matrix betweenthe camera coordinate system and the robot base coordinate system is calculated according to the first position data and the second position data. Calibration can be completed only by acquiring the image information once, so that hand-eye calibration of a robot can be completed quickly, the efficiency is high, the calibration result is accurate, and the requirement on the industrial skill of an operator is relatively low.
source_title: Robot hand-eye calibration method and device, electronic equipment and system

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a robot hand skillfully performing an operation while imitating a hand of an animal (typically a human).

SOLUTION: The robot hand 10 comprises four fingers (an index finger 12, middle finger 14, ring finger 16, and little finger 18) and a fifth finger (a thumb 20). Each of the four fingers is connected to a palm 22 by means of linear motion joints 18h. Each of the four fingers has three rotary joints (first joints 18b, 18d, 18e) corresponding to a DIP joint, PIP joint and MP joint. The robot hand 10 has the linear motion joints 18h which are not provided to a human hand, while imitating the human hand. The linear motion joints 18h can move the whole fingers in parallel while securing the attitude of the fingers. The robot hand 10 is equipped with the linear motion joints 18h to enable skilful operation as compared with a robot hand constituted only of the rotary joints.

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a robot hand having fingers achieved in the compatiblity of stability and dexterity when gripping an object.

SOLUTION: The robot hand 10 having a plurality of fingers including first fingers A, B and second fingers C, D different in shapes of object gripping parts of fingertips. The first fingers A, B are larger in the tip curvature of the fingertips and smaller in the center curvature of the finger tips than the second fingers C, D, and the second fingers C, D are smaller in the tip curvature of the fingertips and larger in the center curvature of the fingertips than the first fingers A, B.
