abstract: A robot hand (10) comprises a first finger part (A), a second finger part (B), a base part (20), and a drive part (DA1). The first finger part (A) comprises a base end link part (A1) that is connected to the base part (20), an intermediate link part (A2) that is connected to the base end link part (A1), a tip end link part (A3) that is connected to the intermediate link part (A2), a passive joint part (PA2) that rotatably supports the base end link part (A1) and the intermediate link part (A2), a passive joint part (PA3) that rotatably supports the intermediate link part (A2) and the tip end link part (A3), and a spring element (SA2) that holds the base end link part (A1) and the intermediate link part (A2) in a basic posture.
source_title: ROBOT HAND

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a tendon rope driving mechanism, a dexterous hand and a robot, and solves the problem that the tendon rope driving mechanism of the dexterous hand does not have self-locking capability. The tendon rope driving mechanism comprises a base, a driving assembly, a wheel shaft, a worm gear, a worm and a tendon rope assembly. The driving assembly is arranged on the base, the wheel shaft is rotatably connected with the base, the worm wheel is coaxially connected with the wheel shaft so as to be rotatably connected with the base through the wheel shaft, the worm is connected with the driving assembly and meshed with the worm wheel, the worm is driven by the driving assembly to rotate and drives the worm wheel to rotate, and the tendon rope assembly is connected with the wheel shaft. The first tendon rope section bypasses one side of the rotating axis from the first side of the wheel shaft and is connected with the knuckles, and the second tendon rope section bypasses the other side of the rotating axis from the second side of the wheel shaft and is connected with the knuckles. According to the tendon rope driving mechanism, the worm drives the worm gear to move through the worm, then the tendon rope assembly is driven to move, and due to the fact that worm gear and worm transmission has self-locking performance, self-locking of the tendon rope driving mechanism is achieved.
source_title: Tendon rope driving mechanism, dexterous hand and robot

abstract: An industrial robot of the articulated arm type having a movable main body (10), an upper arm (16), a forearm (20), and a wrist assembly (30), comprises a forearm (20) provided with a rear extension (26) extending rearward of the axis (4) of articulation between the upper arm (16) and forearm (20). Servo motor (M2, M3, M4) for driving the wrist assembly (30) are mounted on the rear extension (26) in such a manner as to counterbalance the weight of the wrist assembly (30) to ensure prompt robot motion and improve the positioning accuracy of the robot hand.
source_title: INDUSTRIAL ROBOT

abstract: A robot hand for gripping workpieces to be forged which are subjected to impact loads is provided. The robot hand 2 includes a grip 3 for gripping a workpiece to be forged and a grip support 2a for supporting the grip 3. A grip guide 12 for supporting the grip 3 so that it is movable in forward and rearward directions and a spherical seat 5 for bearing the grip guide 12 so that it can be inclined are provided within a casing 4 of the grip body 2a. The casing 3 of the grip support 2a is provided with various actuators 9, 10, 11, 7 for changing the supporting state between a state in which the grip 3 can be moved and inclined and a state in which the grip 3 can not be moved and inclined. The grip 3 is brought into the movable and inclining state for absorbing an impact when the impact load is applied to the gripped workpiece to be forged. <IMAGE>
source_title: Robot hand for forging working

abstract: The present invention relates to a substrate transfer device. The present invention comprises: a robot arm; a robot hand equipped with a substrate wetted with a liquid organic solvent and driven by the robot arm to load the substrate into a chamber and unload the substrate, from which the organic solvent has been removed, from the chamber; and a tray coupled to the robot arm so as to be positioned in a lower portion of the robot hand on which the substrate is mounted, wherein the tray receives the organic solvent flowing down from the substrate. According to the present invention, in a process of transferring the substrate wetted with a liquid organic solvent, the organic solvent flows down to generate a fume and particles are generated in the subsequent process by this fume to solve a problem which causes processing defects.
source_title: SUBSTRATE TRANSFER APPARATUS

abstract: The invention discloses a parallel-clamping and self-adaptive robot finger device enhanced through reverse transmission of differential links, and belongs to the technical field of robot hands. The parallel-clamping and self-adaptive robot finger device enhanced through the reverse transmission of differential links comprises a base, two finger sections, two joint shafts, a motor, a plurality of links, two transmission mechanisms, a spring element and two limit lugs. The device realizes the functions of parallel clamping and self-adaptive grabbing of the fingers of a double-joint robot, and iscapable of translating the second finger section to hold an object or externally expand to take the object, and sequentially rotating the first finger section and the second finger section to envelopobjects with different shapes and sizes according to the different shapes and positions of target objects, and the angle range of the rotation of the second finger section in a self-adaptive processis large. The device is large in grabbing range, and two joints are driven by virtue of one motor in a manner of under-actuated drive, without the need of complex sensing and control systems; and thedevice is simple in structure, small in size, low in manufacturing and maintenance costs, and applicable to a robot hand.
source_title: Parallel-clamping and self-adaptive robot finger device enhanced through reverse transmission of differential links

abstract: Disclosed is a snake robot with an outer cover in a tube form and a control method thereof. According to one aspect of the present invention, the snake robot comprises: a hollow body unit made by connecting a plurality of modules having driving shafts at right angles to each other by a universal joint method; a supply unit connected to one end of the body unit; and a robot hand connected to at least a part of the supply unit to perform a task by gripping or releasing an object. The supply unit includes a tube inserted into the hollow part on the other end of the body unit to move a first material related to the survival of a person to be rescued to the outside through the one end. The present invention is able to shorten or lengthen the distance between the plurality of modules, to reduce or extend the total length of the body unit, to move by using the changes in the total length of the body unit, and to place a contractible/expandable tube on at least a part of a surface of the body unit. The present invention aims to provide the snake robot with the outer cover in the tube form and the control method thereof, capable of increasing the ability of securing the safety of the person to be rescued.
source_title: SNAKE ROBOT USING OUTER COVER OF TUBE FORM AND CONTROL METHOD THEREOF

abstract: The invention provides a passive side swing assembly, a dexterous hand finger, a dexterous hand and a robot, and the passive side swing assembly is used for being arranged in the dexterous hand finger and comprises a base, a top seat and a transmission block; the top seat and the base are oppositely arranged; the first end of the transmission block is rotatably connected with the base, the second end of the transmission block is rotatably connected with the top seat, and the base and the top seat are further used for limiting the swing direction of the transmission block so that the transmission block can swing in the first direction when the passive side swing assembly is subjected to external force. The two ends of the transmission block are rotationally connected with the base and the top base correspondingly, the swing direction of the transmission block is limited through the base and the top base, the transmission block can swing in the first direction when subjected to external force, and therefore lateral swing of the fingers of the dexterous hand is achieved. Due to the fact that a side-sway motor does not need to be arranged, the passive side-sway structure can reduce the structural complexity and cost of the dexterous hand and reduce energy consumption.
source_title: Passive side swaying assembly, dexterous hand finger, dexterous hand and robot

abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent medicine delivery inspection robot for an old-age care institution. The intelligent medicine delivery inspection robot comprises a first mechanical arm, a second mechanical arm, a mobile navigation AMR chassis and a control system, the first mechanical arm is a six-axis mechanical arm, the tail end of the first mechanical arm is connected with a bionic dexterous hand used for grabbing medicine, a robot vision system is installed at the joint of the bionic dexterous hand and the first mechanical arm, and the robot vision system comprises a 2D camera and a 3D camera; the second mechanical arm is provided with an object placing table; the mobile navigation AMR chassis is used for enabling the robot to autonomously move to a specified position through autonomous navigation; the control system comprises a voice interaction module, a face recognition module, a fall monitoring module and a main control module. The system can move autonomously, avoids collision, automatically carries out medicine distribution and safety inspection, supports voice interaction and visual recognition, and improves the service quality and efficiency of the old-age care institution.
source_title: Intelligent medicine delivery inspection robot for old-age care institutions

abstract: To allow a user to easily create a program for a robot.SOLUTION: A measuring device 100 comprises: a position determination processing unit 22 for, on the basis of a result of measurement by a measuring part 20 and gripping information, determining a gripping position with a robot hand HND on a workpiece WK placed in a work space and determining coordinates of a fixed via point having arbitrary one attribute out of an approach position, a gripping position and a retreat position after gripping of the robot hand HND for gripping the gripping position; and an output unit 24 for outputting, to a robot controller 6, the coordinates of the fixed via point and attribute information indicating the attribute of the fixed via point determined by the position determination processing unit 22.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
source_title: MEASURING DEVICE

abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a human body type robot hand having a bending and stretching function of each finger, a moving function facing a thumb to other fingers, and an opening/closing (abduction) function between fingers. SOLUTION: This human body type robot hand comprises 5 finger mechanisms, corresponding to five fingers of human being, and a palm portion corresponding to a palm and supporting the five finger mechanisms. The movement of the first finger mechanism corresponding to the thumb has three degrees of freedom, and the bending and stretching of each of the other second to fifth fingers has one degree of freedom. Abduction between the latter four fingers has one degree of freedom. The human body type robot hand has total eight degrees of freedom.
source_title: HUMAN BODY TYPE ROBOT HAND

abstract: PURPOSE: A robot hand is provided to have a finger module grabbing an object which can unlimitedly rotate around a shaft as a center, thereby smoothly performing the work needed for continuous rotation. CONSTITUTION: A robot hand (100) comprises first and second base members (110, 130), a rotary shaft (150) and a slip ring. The first base member has a first finger module with multiple joints. The second base member has a second finger module with multiple joints. The rotary shaft is connected with one of the first and second base members. The slip ring electrically connects a base member which is not connected to the rotary shaft with the rotary shaft. The base member which is not connected to the rotary shaft can rotate around the rotary shaft as a center.
source_title: ROBOTIC HAND

abstract: An objective of the present invention is to provide a robot hand including a joint on which a direct driving unit is installed. To achieve the objective, the robot hand consists of a plurality of finger mechanisms. The plurality of finger mechanisms include bendable and stretchable joints. The bendable and stretchable joint includes: a first power transfer member; a joint driving unit fixed on the first power transfer member; and a coupler installed on an end of a driveshaft of the joint driving unit to be relatively rotated with respect to the first power transfer member. The joint driving unit is directly installed on the joint by the configuration to provide a joint configuration capable of directly controlling an operation of the joint. And in the robot hand, the coupler is fastened to the joint driving unit while the coupler is elastically deformed by a fastening groove to sturdily couple the coupler to the joint driving unit to secure transfer power to other links.
source_title: ROBOT HAND

abstract: PURPOSE: A calibration method of a position is provided to calibrate an error in the position of a hand caused by the weight of freight that the hand of a robot lifts. CONSTITUTION: A device for compensating location includes a detecting unit of parallelism generating an electric signal in proportional to the parallelism of a third link against a second link and a control unit treating the electric signal from the detecting unit of parallelism for compensating the control signal from a first joint. Herein, the detecting unit of flatness includes a luminous element radiating light by being fixed on the second link and a detecting device of light installed on the third link for generating the electric signal proportional to the amount of incident light from the luminous device. Therefore, the error in the location of a robot hand caused by the weight of freight lifted by the robot hand for enhancing the precision in the control of the robot.
source_title: POSITION COMPENSATION APPARATUS OF ROBOT HAND

abstract: A finger of a robotic hand includes a palm portion, a fixed phalanx fixed to the palm portion, a first movable phalanx rotatably connected to the fixed phalanx, a second movable phalanx rotatably connected to the first movable phalanx, a first pulling member to pull the first movable phalanx so as to rotate the first movable phalanx with respect to the fixed phalanx, a second pulling member to pull the second movable phalanx so as to rotate the second movable phalanx with respect to the first movable phalanx, and an actuator to pull the first pulling member.
source_title: Finger of robotic hand and robot having the same

abstract: The invention discloses a collaborative multi-finger manipulator and a robot system. The collaborative multi-finger manipulator comprises a base, wherein a fixed driving mechanism is arranged on the base; at least a first driving mechanism, a second driving mechanism and a third driving mechanism are arranged around the fixed driving mechanism; the fixed driving mechanism is used for driving a first mechanical finger connected with the fixed driving mechanism; the first driving mechanism is used for driving a first movable mechanical finger connected with the first driving mechanism; the second driving mechanism is used for driving a second movable mechanical finger connected with the second driving mechanism; the third driving mechanism is connected with the first driving mechanism and the second driving mechanism through a transmission mechanism, and used for driving the first movable mechanical finger and the second movable mechanical finger to rotate along the axes of the corresponding driving mechanisms; all the mechanical fingers have a plurality of degrees of freedom of motion; and the gripping operation can be achieved by utilizing the multi-degree-of-freedom motion of eachmechanical finger and adjusting the own direction of each movable mechanical finger.
source_title: Collaborative multi-finger manipulator and robot system

abstract: The invention discloses an upper and lower linkage rod parallel clamping adaptive robot finger device, and belongs to the robot hand technology field. The upper and lower linkage rod parallel clampingadaptive robot finger device comprises a base, two finger segments, two joint shafts, a driver, two gears, a linkage mechanism, a sliding block, a reed and the like. The upper and lower linkage rod parallel clamping adaptive robot finger device comprehensively realizes the parallel clamping and adaptive grabbing functions, not only can enable the second finger segment to perform translational motion so as to pinch objects or stretch to prop up the objects according to different shapes and positions of the target objects, but also can sequentially rotate the first finger segment and the secondfinger segment so as to contain the objects different in shape and size, is large in grabbing range, adopts an under-actuation mode, drives two joints by using the driver, does not need a complex sensing and controlling system, and is compact in structure, small in size, low in manufacture and maintenance cost, and suitable for robot hands.
source_title: Upper and lower linkage rod parallel clamping adaptive robot finger device

abstract: The invention provides a self-adaptive robot hand device with elastic deflection rod clusters wound by flexible pieces and belongs to the technical field of robots. The self-adaptive robot hand device comprises a base, a driver, the flexible pieces, a porous elastic block, multiple sliding push rods, springs and the like. The multiple sliding push rods are adopted for the self-adaptive robot hand device to achieve the function of self-adaptation to the sizes and the shapes of target objects; the driver is adopted to drive a transmission mechanism so that the flexible pieces can contract so as to drive the multiple sliding push rods to gather towards the center of the device, and the multi-directional grasping effect on the target objects is achieved; the porous elastic block is adopted to keep the sliding push rods at the standard positions, and meanwhile the condition that the sliding push rods gather and deflect under the binding action of the flexible pieces is not affected; the self-adaptive robot hand device is used for a robot to grab the target objects, and the self-adaptive grapping function in discrete space is achieved; and the self-adaptive robot hand device is simple in structure, low in energy consumption and good in reliability.
source_title: Self-adaptive robot hand device with elastic deflection rod clusters wound by flexible pieces

abstract: The invention relates to a robot (1) having a robot base (2), a rotatable robot link (5), a proximal robot arm (6), a distal robot arm (7) and a robot hand axis (8). According to the invention, the first robot axis (A1) between the robot base (2) and the rotatable robot link (5) and the fourth robot axis (A4) between the distal robot arm (7) and the robot hand axis (8) lie in offset axis planes regardless of the robot position.
source_title: ROBOT WITH OFFSET AXIS PLANES

abstract: The present invention provides a micro electro-hydraulic linear actuator and an electro-hydraulic actuated robot dexterous hand. The micro electro-hydraulic linear actuator comprises an actuator base (3), a spherical pump unit, and a reciprocating piston mechanism packaged in a closed elastic bladder (1); a hydraulic cylinder (25) and a cylinder liner (26) are arranged on the actuator base (3); both the hydraulic cylinder (25) and the cylinder liner (26) are cylindrical accommodating cavities having one ends open; the open end of the hydraulic cylinder (25) is arranged with a hydraulic cylinder end cap (19); the open end of the cylinder liner is arranged with a motor end cap; the reciprocating piston mechanism is arranged in the hydraulic cylinder (25); a spherical pump and a motor are integrated in the cylinder liner (26) to form the spherical pump unit. In the present invention, a distributed hydraulic source serves as drive force, no reversing valve is needed, there is no need to arrange a complex oil path pipeline in a system, the size is small, the power density is large, the flexibility is good, and an impact load can be withdrawn; and modular design is used and thus the use is convenient.
source_title: MICRO ELECTRO-HYDRAULIC LINEAR ACTUATOR AND ELECTRO-HYDRAULIC ACTUATED ROBOT DEXTEROUS HAND

abstract: The invention discloses an idle running transmission connecting rod gear parallel clamping self-adaptation robot finger device, and belongs to the technical field of robot hands. The device comprises a base, two finger segments, two joint shafts, a motor, two belt wheels, a plurality of gears, a parallel four-connecting-rod mechanism, two convex blocks, a limiting block, two spring parts and the like. According to the device, the robot finger parallel clamping and self-adaption composite grabbing mode is comprehensively achieved; by means of the device, the second finger segment can be transversely moved to pinch an object, the action personification degree is high, after the first finger segment rotates to touch the object, the second finger segment is rotated to envelop and hold the object, the grabbing strength is large, and the self-adaptation grabbing effect of objects in different shapes and with different sizes can be achieved; the device is stable and reliable in grabbing, only one motor is utilized for driving two joints, a complex sensor and a real-time control system are not needed, meanwhile, the structure is simple, the size is small, the weight is small, and machining, assembling and maintaining cost is low; and the device is suitable for the robot hand.
source_title: Idle running transmission connecting rod gear parallel clamping self-adaptation robot finger device

abstract: A multi-articulated robot arm is provided to improve physical property of the multi-articulated robot arm by fabricating the multi-articulated robot arm using a carbon fiber, instead of a metal, such that the total weight of a robot is reduced. A multi-articulated robot arm comprises first and second carbon fiber bar flanges(310,320) coupled with two opposite ends of a plurality of carbon fiber bars(110), a first robot body connector(510) having one side coupled to the first carbon fiber flange and an opposite side connected to a robot body, a first coupling tool(610), a first robot hand flange(420), and a second coupling tool(620). The first and second carbon fiber bar flanges arrange the carbon fiber bars in a circular pattern or a polygonal pattern. The first coupling tool connects the first robot body connector and the first carbon fiber bar flange with one side of the carbon fiber bar. The second coupling tool connects the first robot hand and the second carbon fiber bar flange with the opposite side of the carbon fiber bar.
source_title: ARTICULATED ROBOT ARM

abstract: The present invention comprises: a switching unit (32) which can switch the operating mode of a robot to a hand teaching mode; an instruction unit (33) which, when the operating mode is the hand teaching mode, issues an operation instruction to a control unit (11) of a robot arm (1) of the robot so as to immobilize the position and attitude of the robot arm (1), and issues an operation instruction to a control unit (21) of a robot hand (2) of the robot so as to move the robot hand (2) in a manner following an external force; and a recording control unit (35) which, when the operating mode is the hand teaching mode, records, in a recording unit (31), data indicating the current degree of opening of the robot hand (2) in response to an operation by an operator.
source_title: TEACHING DEVICE

abstract: A robot hand device according to an embodiment includes extensible arms which can be extended and shortened, a drive motor, and at least one clutch. The extensible arms support an object to be carried and are capable of being extended and shortened. The drive motor extends and shortens the extensible arms. The at least one clutch are capable of transmitting power of the motor to at least one of the extensible arms selected among the extensible arms to extend and shorten the selected at least one of the extensible arms.
source_title: Robot hand device and carrier apparatus using the robot hand device

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, device and equipment for in-hand operation of a robot and a computer readable storage medium. According to the method, for a three-finger robot hand configured with a touch sensor, training of an in-hand operation strategy is carried out in a physical simulator, and the learned in-hand operation strategy is applied to a real robot, a deep reinforcement learning method is used, a contact center position of a robot hand and a target object is used as partial observation to carry out strategy training, a joint model of finger joints is calibrated by considering mechanical backlash and self-locking characteristics of a robot, and an initial training state is randomized to ensure successful transfer from a training strategy to a real robot. Therefore, the flexible and continuous in-hand operation of the robot on the target object is realized. According to the method, a better strategy can be trained by using the estimated contact center position as observation, and the learned strategy has good performance in simulation and real world experiments and has good generalization ability.
source_title: Method, device and equipment for in-hand operation of robot and storage medium

abstract: [Problem] To provide a robot hand finger that has a tactile sensor and, when using a robot hand that has a tactile sensor, can suppress damage or malfunctions caused by an object to be gripped being in contact with a section other than the palm surface of the finger . [Solution] This finger with tactile sensor 1F is a finger on a robot hand that grips an object to be gripped, and comprises: a finger 2 that has a palm surface 21a that comes in contact with the object to be gripped, a rear surface 21b on the opposite side to the palm surface 21a, a tip surface 21c adjacent to the palm surface 21a and the rear surface 21b, at the tip in the extension direction of the palm surface 21a and the rear surface 21b, and side surfaces 21d, 21d that are adjacent, on both sides, to the palm surface 21a and the rear surface 21b, in a direction intersecting the extension direction of the palm surface 21a and the rear surface 21b; and a tactile sensor main body 5 which is a film-like material laminated onto the outer surface of a case 21 that constitutes the finger 2, said tactile sensor main body having a pressure-sensitive area 5a that overlaps across at least the palm surface 21a, the tip surface 21c, or the two side surfaces 21d, 21d.
source_title: FINGER WITH TACTILE SENSOR FOR ROBOT HAND AND ROBOT HAND WITH TACTILE SENSOR USING SAME

abstract: An autonomous and adaptable AI-powered robotic workstation system is designed for diverse real-world applications. This includes a configurable workstation seamlessly integrating a dynamic robotic hand, endowed with real-time decision-making capabilities. The workstation features an automatic calibration and self-configuration mechanism utilizing six-axis motion for task execution, ensuring alignment and auto-positioning via cameras. A dynamic and no-code onboarding process with auto-calibration captures and stores product onboarding, optimization of object categorization and prioritizing captures using vision AI. The system also includes a vision-based operations module with AI-driven functionality, integrated hardware, scalable design, calibration capabilities, and unification of specified operations within the same workstation system.
source_title: AI-POWERED ROBOTIC WORKSTATION SYSTEM

abstract: The invention relates to a robot arm (1) for a robot (10), said robot arm comprising a robot hand axis (2) having a plurality of arm segments (3, 4), wherein a first arm segment (3) and a second arm segment (4) of the robot hand axis (2) are mounted relative to one another by means of at least one angular contact needle bearing (5) comprising a rotationally fixed first bearing ring (6) and a second bearing ring (7) mounted so as to be rotatable relative thereto, wherein the rotationally fixed first bearing ring (6) is supported on the first arm segment (3), wherein the rotatably mounted second bearing ring (7) is supported on the second arm segment (4) and is operatively connected to at least one first cable (12a) which is designed to adjust the rotational position of the second bearing ring (7) relative to the first bearing ring (6) in at least a first direction of rotation by actuation by means of a motor unit (8). The invention also relates to a robot (10) comprising such a robot arm (1).
source_title: ROBOT ARM, AND ROBOT COMPRISING A ROBOT ARM

abstract: The invention relates to a method for monitoring a supply system of a robot, which has a robotic arm (1) and a robotic hand (3) movable relative thereto, the supply system having a supply line (7), in particular a hose assembly (9), and having a guide (14, 30) for the supply line (7) and the supply line (7) being guided along the robotic arm (1) in order to supply the robotic hand (3), the supply system also having a number of sensors (20, 22) for monitoring at least one state variable of the supply system, the functional capability of the supply system being inferred from the values for the state variable that are determined by the sensors (20, 22).
source_title: METHOD FOR MONITORING A SUPPLY SYSTEM OF A ROBOT

abstract: A piano-playing man-simulated robot hand is provided. Each finger of the piano-playing man-simulated robot hand is independently controlled and driven by a pneumatic brake line, so demand for speed ofmechanical hand fingers can be met. Hand part control data can be collected by a data glove and an orientation tracker at a virtual-reality environment; and a more natural way is provided for control. Demand for speed of the mechanical hand for playing the piano can be met by a mechanical hand hardware structure and a driving way; a control software interface is simple and easy to use; and the virtual-reality environment enables a user without professional knowledge and training to collect movement data in a natural operation way, so system use limitations can be reduced.
source_title: Piano-playing man-simulated robot hand

abstract: A robot hand includes a finger unit that includes a first knuckle section that is supported to a predetermined base section and a second knuckle section that is supported to the first knuckle section; a drive section that includes a male screw that is rotatable around a predetermined screw axis by a predetermined drive source and a female screw that is screw-coupled with the male screw and moves in an axial direction of the screw axis according to rotation of the male screw, in which the female screw and the first knuckle section are connected to each other so that the first knuckle section moves in association with movement of the female screw; and a link section that connects the first knuckle section and the second knuckle section so that the second knuckle section moves in association with movement of the first knuckle section.
source_title: Robot hand and robot device

abstract: The invention discloses a fingertip vision ridge recognition self-adaptive robot hand device and belongs to the technical field of robot hand vision. The fingertip vision ridge recognition self-adaptive robot hand device comprises a base, three motors, a transmission mechanism, a first joint shaft, a palm, two parallel clamping fingers, two cameras, an image processing module, a controller and the like. The device achieves the robot hand grabbing orientation self adjustment function and the parallel clamping adapting to situations that an object is not in the center. The device has a parallel clamping and grabbing mode, ridge recognition is carried out on the object to be grabbed through vision detection, and the grabbing orientation of the palm and the fingers is adjusted automatically according to the ridge recognition result; and movement of the different fingers is controlled automatically according to the vision feedback about whether the device makes contact with the object to be grabbed or not, and accordingly the object not in the center can be well grabbed.
source_title: Fingertip vision ridge recognition self-adaptive robot hand device

abstract: The invention relates to a hand, in particular to a flexible self-adaption under-actuated robot hand. The flexible self-adaption under-actuated robot hand comprises fingers and a wrist; the wrist includes a skeleton, a direct-current motor, a potentiometer and a winch; the direct-current motor is fixedly connected to a motor mounting surface of the skeleton; the potentiometer is fixedly connected to a potentiometer mounting surface of the skeleton by penetrating through an output shaft of the motor; the winch is fixedly connected to the tail end of the output shaft of the motor; multiple fingers are provided; and the fingers are embedded in clamping grooves of the skeleton or multiple clamping grooves through convex blocks of rotating bodies. The flexible self-adaption under-actuated robot hand is assembled at the tail end of an industrial robot for assisting mechanical assembly or mechanical manufacturing process and finishing automatic workpiece loading/unloading; and the fingers can flexibly adapt to geometric shapes of products, and realize automatic adjustment according to the geometric shapes of workpieces to realize stable grabbing.
source_title: Flexible self-adaption under-actuated robot hand

abstract: In this robot hand, a pair of bits (64) are opened and closed to grab a microtube (19). Said robot hand is characterized by the provision of the following: claw parts (71) that contact the outer surface of a container body (19a) or lid (19b) of a microtube (19) as a result of the aforementioned opening and closing; and rectangular recesses (70) into which part of the aforementioned lid (19b) and part of a flange (19d) are inserted with the claw parts (71) contacting the outer surface of the microtube (19). The robot hand is also characterized in that: each rectangular recess (70) is formed in a rectangular shape with a pair of surfaces between which the aforementioned lid (19b) and flange (19d) are clamped; and by closing the pair of bits (64) with the edges of the rectangular recesses (70) in contact with the outer surface of the container body (19a), the microtube (19) is held in an orientation different from the orientation in which the lid (19b) is inserted into the rectangular recesses (70).
source_title: ROBOT HAND AND ROBOT

abstract: A robot controller (1) has a display panel (1b) and a main body (1a) comprising an NC controller (1d), an electric power board (1e), an optical emitter (1f) and a receiver (1g). The robot has a hand, arms and drive mechanisms. The robot and the controller are connected by cables (19) for electric power transmission and by optical fibre cables for signal transmission. Instructions from the NC controller are converted into optical pulse signal (20) and transmitted along the fibre cable to the robot hand, where the signals are again converted into electronic signals, whilst signals from sensors attached to the robot hand are converted into optical signal and seed back to the controller.
source_title: ROBOT CONTROLLER.

abstract: The invention concerns a member, driven by pressure medium and forming a pivoted link, e.g. for a robot hand, gripping and holding member or similar frame 16, which can be controlled over a range from a bent position to an stretched out position, and vice versa. The member - frame 16 - has been made of a flexible wall material, whereby a first type of wall has one or more locally delimited internal pocket constructions 11, and a pressure medium tube 21 connected to them, also a second type of wall but without the same wall constructions. The first wall material type has been designed to be deformed by filling the pocket construction(s), and analogously by pressing together the width and length of the wall part situated nearby. The second type of wall material forms a reinforcement part for the wall part(s) of the first wall material type. The first wall part has been arranged at a distance from the second wall part, so that the first wall part can be bent relative to the second wall part by filling the pocket construction(s) 11 with pressure medium, and the first type of wall can be straightened relative to the second type of wall by removing pressure medium from the pocket construction(s). <IMAGE>
source_title: ARRANGEMENT FOR PIVOT LINK-FORMING MEANS

abstract: The invention provides a double-follow-up intelligent arm control method based on a four-axis mechanical arm. The method comprises the following steps that a hydraulic cylinder works to drive the mechanical arm to move and determine a target object; the pose of the target object in a world coordinate system is determined; and mechanical arm motion compensation is performed to move the mechanical arm to a target pose. The follow-up intelligent arm is combined with robot hand-in-eye to construct a double-follow-up intelligent control system. An inertial navigation system is additionally arrangedon the basis of adding an attitude sensor, the refreshing frequency is more than 100HZ, and when a ship and an automobile bumps, attitude information such as the speed, the yaw angle and the positionof a carrier is efficiently measured, so that the tail end of the manipulator is kept relatively motionless. Simultaneously, the feedback (the refreshing frequency is more than 10Hz) of a mechanicalstructure terminal vision (sonar) device is utilized for target monitoring and motion compensation. Sea waves and jolts can be offset, and the target can be subjected to monitoring and systematic correction through the hand-in-eye, and double-follow-up control of the system is realized.
source_title: Double-follow-up intelligent arm control method based on four-axis structure

abstract: The present invention relates to a robotic hand and a method for automating the assembly of lenses in a frame, for use in the optical and ophthalmic industry, to reduce production costs related to the hiring of staff to assemble the lenses and the deterioration of the health of workers in the industry, caused by constant temperature changes during the production process. The objective is achieved by using a robotic arm with a robotic hand capable of performing fine movements without damaging the integrity of the lens material or the lenses in the production process, and a rotary indexing table.
source_title: METHOD FOR AUTOMATING THE ASSEMBLY OF LENSES IN A FRAME BY MEANS OF A ROBOTIC ARM

abstract: Examples of a method for teaching a transportation position includes correcting the position of an alignment jig having a plurality of sloping surfaces relative to a susceptor pin projecting upwards from an upper surface of a susceptor by lowering a robot hand to bring one of the sloping surfaces into contact with the susceptor pin and causing the susceptor pin to slide on the sloping surfaces by virtue of an own weight of the aliment jig, detecting a position of the alignment jig before and after the positional correction of the alignment jig, and correcting a movement destination information by an amount corresponding to a difference between an initial position and a corrected position of the alignment jig.
source_title: Method for teaching a transportation position and alignment jig

abstract: A method of handling a wire harness that can automate a task of picking up and transporting the wire harness including a plurality of connectors and a wire member by gripping the plurality of connectors. In the method, positions of the plurality of connectors of the wire harness being placed apart from the robot hand are acquired, the robot hand is positioned such that the first connector is in the range of the first gripper based on the acquired position of the first connector, the first gripper is moved and the first connector is gripped and picked up by the first gripper, then, the robot hand is positioned such that the second connector is in the motion range of the second gripper based on the acquired position of the second connector, and the second gripper is moved and the second connector is gripped and picked up by the second gripper.
source_title: Robot hand including a plurality of grippers and a method of handling a wire harness using a robot hand

abstract: PURPOSE: An object gripping system and method are provided to improve object gripping efficiency by allowing a robot hand to grip objects in order depending on the exposure rate of the objects. CONSTITUTION: An object gripping system(1) comprises a carrier(20), a robot hand(10), a camera(40), and a controller(50). Objects(30) are received in the carrier. The robot hand grips the objects. The camera is vertically installed to be separated from the carrier. The controller comprises a database which rotates objects and photographs the rotated objects. The controller calculates the exposure rate of each object by comparing the areas of the photographed objects each other. The robot hand grips the objects depending on the exposure rate of the objects.
source_title: Object picking system and object picking method

abstract: Embodiments are directed to a robot hand including a frame, a link member moving relative to the frame, a joint unit provided between the frame and the link member, a drive unit supplying power to the joint unit so as to rotate the link member, and a backlash removal unit supplying constant torque to the joint unit, even if a relative position of the link member to the frame is changed as the link member is rotated.
source_title: Robot hand

abstract: This method for moving the tip of a linear object is a method for moving the tip (W1s) of a linear object (W1) gripped by a robot hand (22) to a target position (TG1), the method comprising: a step for measuring the position of the tip (W1s) of the linear object (W1) gripped by the robot hand (22); and a step for moving the tip (W1s) to the target position (TG1) on the basis of the measured position of the tip (W1s).
source_title: METHOD FOR MOVING TIP OF LINEAR OBJECT, CONTROL DEVICE, AND THREE-DIMENSIONAL CAMERA

abstract: This robot hand comprises a first finger member, an intermediate member roatably connected to the first finger member, a second finger member roatably connected to the intermediate member, and a guide member that is rotatably connected to the second finger member and has a first guide part. The first guide member has a first guided part that is disposed to be rotatable and movable in the first guide part.
source_title: ROBOT HAND AND METHOD FOR OPERATING ROBOT HAND

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a robot hand optimized in surface structure depending on regions.

SOLUTION: The robot hand 1 having a plurality of fingers A, B, C, D comprises a sensor 3 formed of a pressure sensor provided on the surface side of a structure 2, and a covering part 4 formed of a covering material for covering at least the sensor 3. By the constitution of the sensor 3 and/or the covering part 4, the number of fingers having characteristics suitable for performing fine work is larger than the number of fingers having characteristics not suitable for performing fine work. Alternatively, by the constitution of the sensor 3 and/or the covering part 4, the number of fingers having characteristics suitable for gripping is larger than the number of fingers having characteristics not suitable for gripping.
