source_title: ROBOT HAND

abstract: The present invention relates to fine adjustable robot fingers having a configuration in which a gear pair having a V-shape connection structure is respectively arranged adjacent to a joint region of two or more pivot-connected joints; the gear pairs are respectively connected to a power transporting rod through a universal joint; in the power transporting rod, bolts are formed and geared to nuts provided on the joints; a the other end of a variable bar allowing one end to rotate on another joint so as to rotate the joint unit when the nut is moving is connected to the nut; at the last joint, an actuator is provided so as to rotate the last joint when moving by being geared on the power transporting rod, and thereby being capable of fine adjustment and firm grasp, and to a robot hand using the same.
source_title: a robot finger having micro control and robot hand using the same

abstract: An automatic charging robot 1 that performs charging by inserting a charging connector 5 into a charging port of a vehicle, the automatic charging robot 1 includes a robot hand 2 that holds the charging connector 5 when the charging connector 5 is automatically inserted into and removed from the charging port. The robot hand 2 includes a holding device 21 that holds a holding member 7 attached to the charging connector 5, and a plunger 22 that presses, by the holding device 21 being at a position at which the holding member 7 is holdable, a release button 13 provided on the charging connector 5 as an operation unit to release a locked state in which the charging connector 5 inserted into the charging port is locked.
source_title: AUTOMATIC CHARGING ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom full-drive dexterous hand and a robot, and relates to the technical field of dexterous hands. The multi-degree-of-freedom full-drive dexterous hand comprises a palm plate, a thumb assembly and finger assemblies, the thumb assembly is arranged on the front side of the palm plate, and the multiple finger assemblies are arranged at the top of the palm plate at intervals; the position of the thumb assembly can be adjusted in the left-right direction of the palm plate so as to be opposite to one of the finger assemblies, the thumb assembly comprises a distal finger and a plurality of driving units arranged between the distal finger and the palm plate, and bending or stretching of the thumb assembly and the finger assemblies is achieved through the driving units. According to the multi-degree-of-freedom full-drive dexterous hand, the structure is simplified through the modularized and independently-driven driving units, control is convenient, the holding effect of the dexterous hand during holding is enhanced through movement of the thumb assembly relative to the palm plate, and the flexibility and reliability of the dexterous hand during article holding are guaranteed.
source_title: Multi-degree-of-freedom full-drive dexterous hand and robot

abstract: To facilitate mounting and removal of a sensor, which is necessary for a robot hand, without disassembling work of the robot hand.SOLUTION: A sensor module for a robot hand having a plurality of fingers includes a sensor 32 on an outer surface of a flexible base material 31 which can be attached/detached and can be covered on the fingers of the robot hand. The sensor 32 is at least one of a proximity sensor and a tactile sensor, and is positioned in a position corresponding to a tip of the finger of the robot hand.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
source_title: SENSOR MODULE AND ROBOT SYSTEM

abstract: A method and system for monitoring operating state in the control of a robot for actuating a robot hand (1) in accordance with taught data to cause the hand (1) to grip a part (BT) and then service a mate (PB) with the part (BT) in a playback mode. The method includes a step of teaching an operating state by actuating the robot arm or hand in accordance with the taught data and storing in a memory information indicative of a reference state based on an output signal from sensing means (SA, SB) for sensing the state of an operation performed by the robot hand (1). The next step is to monitor the operating state of the robot hand (1) in the playback mode by comparing an output signal from the sensing means (SA, SB) with the reference state stored in the memory.
source_title: ROBOT CONTROL METHOD AND SYSTEM

abstract: This robot system comprises: a robot hand that has a plurality of fingers, a plurality of belts provided to the fingers, and a motor for driving the belts; and a control device that controls the robot hand. In a state of grasping an object, the robot hand is capable of rotating the object about, on three-dimensional coordinate axes, a first axis and a second axis that is different from the first axis, by driving the belts. In the case when the object grasped by the robot hand is to assume a target attitude that is achieved by rotating the object about a third axis, which is orthogonal to the first axis and the second axis, the control device causes the object to transition to said target attitude by combining rotations about the first axis and the second axis.
source_title: ROBOT SYSTEM, DEVICE FOR CONTROLLING ROBOT HAND, AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING ROBOT HAND

abstract: The invention discloses a robot dexterous hand which comprises a palm base, a plurality of swing assemblies, a plurality of first normal fingers and a plurality of driving assemblies, the swing assemblies are arranged on the top of the palm base in an array mode, the first normal fingers are arranged on the tops of the swing assemblies, and the swing assemblies can drive the first normal fingers to swing. The first normal finger comprises a plurality of finger modules, every two adjacent finger modules are in running fit, and a driving assembly is arranged in the first normal finger and used for driving the finger modules to rotate, so that the first normal finger is bent; the first normal finger is divided into the multiple finger modules, the multiple driving assemblies are matched, the finger modules are directly driven to rotate, the structure is simple, and subsequent maintenance is also facilitated through the modular design; compared with the prior art, the driving assemblies are arranged at the joints and matched with the finger modules, starting is simpler and more convenient, and disassembly, assembly and maintenance are also convenient.
source_title: Robot dexterous hand

abstract: The present invention relates to an optimum grinding robot automation system for multi-shape kitchen utensils using a three-dimensional vision technology, which comprises: a multi-joint robot designed to work in a small space with the optimum efficiency; a robot hand magazine holding each robot hand; a three-dimensional vision module attached to each hand of the robot to recognize the positions of products; a robot controller which automatically replaces a hand of the multi-joint robot with another robot hand with a proper function in accordance with the work stage executed; a grinding apparatus which includes an air cylinder and a load cell for securing a uniformity in grinding work by precisely controlling the contact force; and a pallet centering apparatus which uses an alignment unit to perform the fixing and the centering of the pallet at the same time. According to the present invention, a software linked to the three-dimensional vision module is used, so the work accuracy of the robot hand in accordance with the recognition of the product position can be improved in real time. In addition, in accordance with the stage of work executed, a hand of the multi-joint robot can be automatically replaced with another robot hand with the proper functions, so the work efficiency can be maximized. In addition, the present invention is able to use the alignment unit of the pallet centering apparatus, and perform the fixing and centering of the pallet at the same time, thereby inducing a more precise position adjustment of the pallet.
source_title: 3D Optimum Grinding Robot Automation System for 3D Kitchen Utensils Using 3D Vision Technology

abstract: A wrist structure of an industrial robot, in which a beta speed reducer (3) and an alpha speed reducer (5) are provided at one side portion and a front portion, respectively, of the interior of a wrist (1), an outer rotary shaft (2) in a second arm (10) and an inner rotary shaft (4) therein being connected to the beta speed reducer (3) and alpha speed reducer (5), respectively, via a transmission means, and a robot hand retainer (E) being connected directly to the alpha speed reducer (5). This wrist structure is used for an industrial robot having a coaxial wrist.
source_title: WRIST FOR INDUSTRIAL ROBOT

abstract: A method of grasp generation for a robot includes searching within a configuration space of a robot hand model for robot hand configurations to engage an object model with a grasp type. The method includes generating a set of candidate grasps based on the robot hand configurations. Grasping of the object model with the robot hand model is simulated in a physics engine using simulated grasps generated based on a given candidate grasp. A simulated grasp is assigned a score based on a response of the object model to an applied wrench disturbance when the object is engaged with the simulated grasp. The method includes generating a set of feasible grasps for the given candidate grasp based on the respective simulated grasps having a score above a score threshold at a target wrench disturbance.
source_title: METHOD AND SYSTEM OF GRASP GENERATION FOR A ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-fingered dexterous hand grabbing posture generation method and system based on CVAE and a Ball Query algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of robot grabbing control. The method comprises the following steps: (1) a data sampling step; (2) a data preprocessing step: carrying out standardization processing on the collected data, generating enhanced point cloud data and constructing a training data set; (3) a model training step: through a multi-scale feature extraction module, combining global semantics and local geometric features extracted by a Ball Query algorithm, generating a grabbing attitude by using a conditional variation auto-encoder, and optimizing model parameters through reconstruction loss and KL divergence; and (4) real-time deployment: integrating the trained model to a physical platform, screening candidate grabbing postures based on parallel collision detection, and realizing real-time grabbing control in combination with inverse kinematics verification. The problem that a traditional method is insufficient in generalization ability in complex object grabbing is effectively solved, and self-adaptive grabbing of unknown objects is achieved while grabbing stability is guaranteed.
source_title: Dexterous hand grabbing pose generation method and system based on CVAE and Ball Query algorithms

abstract: The invention discloses a robot dexterous arm teleoperation sharing control method and a related device, and relates to the technical field of robotics.The method comprises the steps that smooth expected pose information and expected angle state information are obtained, and pose information of a mechanical arm of a slave end at the current stage and angle state information and contact force information of a dexterous hand are obtained; based on the expected pose information and the joint angle information of the mechanical arm, the inverse kinematics of the mechanical arm is solved through a nonlinear optimization method, and a joint angle instruction of the mechanical arm is obtained; based on the expected angle state information, the angle state information of the dexterous hand and the contact force information, utilizing a fuzzy logic theory and a dynamic compliance primitive model to carry out adaptive variable impedance control on the dexterous hand to obtain a joint torque instruction of the dexterous hand; and feeding back the contact force information of the dexterous hand in the next stage to a main end operator. The success rate and the working efficiency of the teleoperation robot can be improved.
source_title: Robot dexterous arm teleoperation sharing control method and related device

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom continuous robot with a flexible target grabbing function, belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to a multi-degree-of-freedom continuous robot capable of flexibly grabbing small-size objects and curling and winding large-size objects. The multi-degree-of-freedom continuous robot comprises a driving device module, an imitation trunkmodule and a dexterous finger module, and the imitation trunk module is composed of a rotary compression module and a bending compression module; uniform connecting interfaces are reserved at the endsof the modules, and the modules are combined and spliced according to actual requirements; the driving module is arranged on a base of the robot to achieve driving work of all the ropes and control the robot to move; the rotary compression module can simultaneously generate rotation and compression motion, so that the dead angle defect of the bending compression module is overcome; the bending compression module can independently realize compression deformation and bending deformation of the module; and the dexterous finger module achieves the grabbing function through multi-finger cooperation. The robot is simple in structure and flexible to use, and the robot structure has the characteristic of light weight.
source_title: Multi-degree-of-freedom continuous robot with flexible target grabbing function

abstract: The invention provides a double-toggle-joint, connecting rod, linear and parallel clamping and self-adapting type finger device of a robot hand, and belongs to the technical field of robot hands. The double-toggle-joint, connecting rod, linear and parallel clamping and self-adapting type finger device of the robot hand comprises a rack, two finger sections, two housings, two joint shafts, a motor, a plurality of connecting rods, three spring parts, a guide rail and a slide block. With the adoption of the device, fingers of the robot hand can linearly parallelly clamp and adaptively grab, in particularly can clamp a thin-wall workpiece. According to the double-toggle-joint, connecting rod, linear and parallel clamping and self-adapting type finger device of the robot hand, a crank block mechanism meeting a certain condition is utilized to achieve the linear movement of a remote joint shaft and a near joint shaft; a four-connecting-rod mechanism and the spring parts are used in match to remain the second finger section relative to the first finger section at the same location, thus achieving parallel movement; a six-connecting-rod mechanism and the spring parts are used in match to achieve the self-adaptive grabbing function, so as to adapt to grab articles with different shape and size. Therefore, the grabbing range is large, and the grabbing stability and reliability can be ensured; one motor can be used for driving the two finger sections. The device is simple in structure, and low in cost of processing, assembling and repairing.
source_title: Double-toggle-joint, connecting rod, linear and parallel clamping and self-adapting type finger device of robot hand

abstract: Provided is an underactuated robot hand and a robot. The robot hand is provided with a frame and a finger unit (22) which is provided on the frame and which grips a gripping object. The finger unit (22) is provided with the following: a Scott-Russell mechanism (SRM) comprising a swinging lever member (SL) and a conversion link member (41) rotatably connected to an end of the swinging lever member by means of a connecting part positioned at an intermediate part; a first parallel link mechanism comprising at least the swinging lever member (SL) and a common link member (CL) rotatably connected to the connecting part; and a second parallel link mechanism comprising the common link member (CL), the conversion link member (41), a tip part link member (42), and an opposing conversion link member (41f).
source_title: ROBOT HAND AND ROBOT

abstract: A feedback control system for controlling the velocity or (as shown) position of a member 12 uses two control loops which are interlinked by lines 20,21 and also by a control line 16 which responds to the force applied to an input member 10, the resulting system thus giving a sense of feel via a motor 36 to the input member 10 without using a force transducer at the output member. The input demand signal on line 20 is directly proportional to the output position or output velocity. Similarly, the output demand signal on line 21, or the derivative of the output demand signal for velocity control, is directly proportional to the position of the input. Velocity feedback loops 34,39 may be provided. Desirably the output position controller (29) operates under proportional control, and the input position controller operates under PID control. The system may be used to control a robot hand e.g. in nuclear, deep sea or other hostile environments, or a wheelchair. <IMAGE>
source_title: FORCE FEEDBACK CONTROL SYSTEM

abstract: The invention discloses an under-actuated robot dexterous hand finger, belongs to the technical field of robot automation equipment, and solves the technical problems that an existing robot dexteroushand is complex in control system, high in manufacturing cost, relatively stiff in finger strength, prone to generating grabbing damage to fragile objects and the like. According to the technical scheme, the under-actuated robot dexterous hand finger comprises a driving piece, a traction strip, a first knuckle away from a palm center, a second knuckle connected with the first knuckle through a rotating shaft I, a third knuckle connected with the second knuckle through a rotating shaft II and a base connected with the third knuckle through a rotating shaft III; and one end of the traction stripis connected with the driving piece, and the other end of the traction strip is fixedly connected with a pin shaft. Compared with the prior art, the under-actuated robot dexterous hand finger has theadvantages of being simple in structure, safe in operation, convenient to control and the like.
source_title: Under-actuated robot dexterous hand finger

abstract: The present invention relates to a product display robot and an unmanned store product display system including the same. According to one embodiment of the present invention, a product display robot comprises: a main body having wheels provided at a lower portion; an elevating support member having a preset length in the vertical direction and extending upward with respect to the main body; a robot arm connected to the elevating support member so as to be movable in the vertical direction; a robot hand connected to a front end of the robot arm, wherein the robot arm comprises: a main link connected to the elevating support member; a connecting link positioned on one lateral side of the main link and provided so as to be slidable with respect to the main link; and an arm link positioned on one side of the connecting link and provided so as to be slidable with respect to the connecting link.
source_title: Product display robot and unmanned store product display system including same

abstract: A robot hand-eye calibration method and apparatus, a computing device, a medium, and a product. The method comprises: a calibration device (108) at the end of a robot arm (102) is controlled to move to a calibration plate (112); when a force sensor (104) on the robot arm (102) detects that the force of the contact between the end (110) of the calibration device and the calibration plate (112) reaches a predetermined value, the robot arm (102) stops to move, and the end (110) of the calibration device performs marking at the contact position between the end of the calibration device and the calibration plate (112); the robot arm (102) moves upward in the direction perpendicular to the calibration plate (112) and stops at a position where the end of the robot arm (102) is at a predetermined height; at this position, a camera (106) at the end of the robot arm (102) photographs the marks on the calibration plate (112), records the coordinates of the marks in the camera coordinate system, and records the coordinates of the end (110) of the calibration device in the robot coordinate system when the robot arm (102) stops at this position; and a calibration transformation matrix is calculated according to the recorded coordinates of at least three marks on the calibration plate (112) in the camera coordinate system and the corresponding coordinates of the end (110) of the calibration device in the robot coordinate system.
source_title: ROBOT HAND-EYE CALIBRATION METHOD AND APPARATUS, COMPUTING DEVICE, MEDIUM AND PRODUCT

abstract: The robot hand has two moveable digits arranged to permit an object to be grasped between them. The hand is flexibly mounted to a moveable arm. Optical approach sensors are set at the end of each digit and at upper and lower surfaces of digits. Additional sensors (22,23) are fixed to the inside face of each digit. Sensors comprise a light emitting diode and phototransistor both set to look in the same direction. Pulsed beams from light emitting diodes reflect off external surfaces and objects. The reflected light pulses received at phototransistors indicate the existence and distance of onjects and generate signals passed cable to processor which controls movements of arm, hands and digit so as to avoid external obstruction and grasp and move objects as required.
source_title: A ROBOT HAND

abstract: The invention relates to a force information display device. The control unit (11) executes: a first calculation process in which the angle of the robot hand (40) after displacement is calculated on the basis of the angular velocity input from the gyroscope sensor (53); and a first display process or a second display process, the first display process being based on a post-displacement angle of the robot hand (40). And a second display process for converting at least one of a force and a torque in a force sensor coordinate system, which is input from the force sensor (51) and fixed to the force sensor, into at least one of a force and a torque in an absolute coordinate system fixed to the ground, and displaying the converted result on the display (14), the second display process being performed on the basis of a post-displacement angle of the robot hand (40). The relationship between the absolute coordinate system and the force sensor coordinate system is displayed on a display (14).
source_title: Force information display device

abstract: A robot handling system using a robot hand to convey a workpiece, provided with a first wrist element at a front end of an arm of the robot, a second wrist element perpendicular to this, a third wrist element perpendicular to this, and a connecting means connecting the third wrist element and a hand body of the robot hand, the hand body being arranged so that an inertia moment of the hand body about a vertical axial line becomes larger than the inertia moments of the hand body about two mutually perpendicular horizontal axial lines, the connecting means connects the third wrist element and hand body so that a third axial line of the third wrist element and the hand body are arranged in a horizontal plane, and a posture of the hand body is changed about the vertical axial line in the state with the third axial line of the third wrist element arranged in a horizontal plane. Due to this, the robot hand can be made to rotate over the limit of the allowable inertia moment.
source_title: Robot handling system

abstract: The invention discloses a robot hand-eye calibration method and device, a robot and a computer storage medium, and the robot hand-eye calibration method comprises the steps: aligning the center of a camera with the center of a calibration plate, and determining the coordinate point of a mechanical arm at the moment; according to the determined coordinate point of the mechanical arm, a plurality of photographing point positions are generated according to a preset rule; the mechanical arm is controlled to sequentially move to all the photographing point positions, the calibration plate is photographed through the camera, and position information of the mechanical arm is correspondingly recorded; and performing hand-eye calibration based on an image shot by the camera and the position information of the mechanical arm. According to the hand-eye calibration method of the robot, the multiple mechanical arm photographing point positions can be automatically generated according to the preset rule according to the coordinate points of the mechanical arm when the camera is aligned with the center of the calibration plate, compared with the mode that the mechanical arm is manually moved to determine the photographing point positions, operation is easy, time is saved, calibration efficiency is improved, and the calibration accuracy is improved. It can be guaranteed that large posture differences exist between the photographing point positions, and the calibration effect is improved.
source_title: Robot hand-eye calibration method and device, robot and computer storage medium

abstract: The rigidity-variable single-finger skeleton of the rigid-flexible coupling dexterous hand comprises a fingertip, a middle knuckle and a tail knuckle, the middle knuckle is movably connected with the fingertip through a joint, and the middle knuckle is movably connected with the tail knuckle through a joint; each joint comprises a shell, an air bag arranged in the shell and a set of rotating bosses which penetrate through the wall of the shell and are coaxially arranged; the rotating bosses can move along the axis; one of the middle knuckle and the fingertip which are connected with each other is rotationally connected with the rotating bosses, and one of the middle knuckle and the tail knuckle which are connected with each other is rotationally connected with the rotating bosses; each shell is provided with a pipe opening into which an air pipe for inflating the corresponding air bag extends; and when the air bags expand, the outer walls of the air bags abut against one ends of the rotating bosses to drive the rotating bosses to move towards the two sides along the axis, and the other ends of the rotating bosses abut against the fingertip, the middle knuckle or the tail knuckle. The rigidity of soft robot finger joints can be quickly and efficiently changed, and fingers can be better attached to an object and grasp a vulnerable object better.
source_title: Variable-rigidity single-finger skeleton of rigid-flexible coupling dexterous hand

abstract: A control device includes a force detector configured to detect a force in a normal direction and a force in a shearing direction of fingertips of a robot hand device respectively as a normal force and a shearing force, and an object detector configured to calculate a friction coefficient using the normal force and the shearing force detected by the force detector and to detect whether or not a thin-film object having a maximum friction coefficient different from a maximum stationary friction coefficient between the fingertips is grasped between the fingertips on the basis of the calculation result.
source_title: Control device, control method, and program

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot hands, and particularly relates to a robot hand based on universal joints. The robot hand based on the universal joints comprises a palm and a finger control mechanism, wherein the finger control mechanism is mounted on a robot body, and five finger units are mounted on a palm shell. The robot hand based on the universal joints has the functions of grabbing objects and drilling specific objects; the finger universal joints are used for driving the finger units to move in any directions, and thus the function of grabbing objects is achieved; and meanwhile, the finger units can be driven to rotate, so that the function of drilling specific parts is achieved, and the robot hand has good practical effects.
source_title: Robot hand based on universal joints

abstract: To provide a compact capacitive pressure sensor for robots, capable of sensing pressure exerted on a robotic hand and soles of a traveling robot.SOLUTION: A capacitive pressure sensor provided herein comprises: a panel electrode E having a conductive surface at least on one side; a panel electrode S having a conductive surface at least on one side; at least one dielectric sheet inserted between the panel electrode E and/or the panel electrode S; and an elastic separator, containing air bubbles, inserted to directly or indirectly cover the panel electrode E or the panel electrode S.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
source_title: CAPACITIVE PRESSURE SENSOR

abstract: To provide a robot hand which can sense that a finger part of the robot hand has come into contact with an object, and which can reduce the contact between a vibration sensor and the object.SOLUTION: A robot hand is provided which includes: a base part; at least one finger part, which is at least one finger part connected to the base part, and which includes at least a base joint connected to the base part and an end joint at a tip; and a vibration sensor capable of detecting vibration transmitted from the at least one finger part. The robot hand has a back side and a palm side, and the vibration sensor is arranged on the back side.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A
source_title: ROBOT HAND INCLUDING VIBRATION SENSOR AND ROBOT SYSTEM INCLUDING THE SAME

abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a robot hand with flexibility, decorativeness and behavior of a human hand by moving a plurality of fingers by a one-axis drive source to works to be held including those of different diameter. SOLUTION: A multi-finger movable robot hand comprises at least two fingers (an index finger 16, a middle finger 17, a ring finger 18 and a little finger 19) which have joints and disposed parallel to each other, a thumb disposed facing these fingers, and a flexible member pulled to bend the joints of at least two fingers except the thumb. The power generated from one drive source 1 is transmitted to at least two flexible members via at least one running block (10 and 11) in order to enable the holding motion by bringing at least two fingers and the thumb into contact with the works to be held including those of different diameter, and the holding power is generated in at least two fingers by pulling each flexible member.
source_title: MULTI-FINGER-MOVABLE ROBOT HAND, AND HOLD CONTROL METHOD THEREOF

abstract: The robot hand according to one embodiment of the present technology is provided with a finger unit and a guide member. The finger unit is configured to be capable of holding a flexible linear member such that the linear member can slide in the long side direction of the linear member, said linear member having one end that is fixed. The guide member is attached to the finger unit, and has a guide section for guiding the linear member to a predetermined position.
source_title: ROBOT HAND, ROBOT DEVICE, AND METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING ELECTRONIC APPARATUS

abstract: The present invention relates to a robot hand for assembling a brake module of a car, which comprises: a driving unit which is installed on the bottom of an arm in order to rotate according to the operation of a driving motor; a driven unit which is installed on the bottom of the driving unit, and has a driven shaft in order to be rotated by receiving rotational force of the driving unit by being connected with the driving unit through a power transmitting means; a first fixating member whose one end is fixated to the driven shaft of the driven unit, and where a first catch unit moving to the left and the right in a horizontal direction is installed at the other end thereof; a second fixating member whose top central part is connected with one side lower part of the first fixating member, whose top is formed in order to cross at a right angle to the first fixating member, and where a second catch unit moving to the up and the down in a vertical direction in a downwardly bending state is installed at both ends thereof; and a third fixating member which is installed at the top central part of the second fixating member by crossing at a right angle to the second fixating member, and where a third catch unit moving to the front and the back in a horizontal direction in a downwardly bending state is installed at both ends thereof. Therefore, the robot hand for assembling a brake module of a car can accurately and effectively grasp each component of a brake module using the hands of a multi-joint robot by adding a single axle extra degree of freedom to the hands of the existing six axle multi-joint robot, can increase accuracy in assembling the brake module, and can further improve productivity according to the shortening of a cycle time of the assembling process by softening and simplifying the assembly and transfer work of the brake module.
source_title: Car brake module for assembly robot hand

abstract: The invention discloses a robot dexterous hand and a robot. The robot dexterous hand comprises a palm main plate, a plurality of first fingers and a first driving assembly. The first fingers are rotationally connected to the palm main plate. The first driving assembly comprises a first driving part and a plurality of first transmission assemblies, the first driving part is installed on the palm main plate, the output end of each first transmission assembly is in transmission connection with one first finger, and the input end of each first transmission assembly is in transmission connection with the first driving part; the first driving piece can drive the multiple first fingers to swing through the multiple first transmission assemblies. According to the robot dexterous hand, one first drive can drive the multiple fingers to swing at the same time, so that the occupied space can be saved, and the structural compactness of the robot dexterous hand can be improved.
source_title: Robot dexterous hand and robot

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a robot hand which smoothly moves long items of different widths and thicknesses such as a remote control and a handset of a telephone.

SOLUTION: The robot hand 10 is provided with a thumb 11, a forefinger 12, a middle finger 13, a ring finger 14, a little finger 15, a palm part 16 for supporting above fingers 11-15 by their roots, and a carrying belt mechanism 17 provided on the palm part 16. The carrying belt mechanism 17 comprises a carrying belt 17a disposed to diagonally traverse the palm part 16. The carrying belt 17a is rotated normally and inversely as illustrated with an arrow A, so that a subject item in contact with the carrying belt 17a is carried normally or inversely. The carrying surface of the carrying belt 17a is inclined by an angle α in the crossing direction to the carrying direction illustrated with the arrow A to the surface of the palm part 16.

source_title: ROBOT HAND

abstract: The present invention relates to a robot hand installed in an end arm of a six-axis articulated robot including: a driving unit installed in the lower part of the arm and proving driving power generated by a servo motor; a driven unit installed in the lower part of the driving unit to be able to rotate, connected to the driving unit by a power transmitting means, and receiving the driving power generated by the servo motor of the driving motor; a first fixing member of which a rear end is fixated to the front part of the driven unit and first grippers facing each other and moving in a vertical direction are formed in a front end; a pair of second fixing members extended downward in a vertical direction from both ends of the driving unit and having second grippers facing each other and moving in a horizontal direction in the lower parts; and a pair of third fixing members formed on the bottom surface of the driven unit to face each other and having third grippers moving in a vertical direction in the front ends. According to this, the present invention is capable of improving the accuracy of assembling components with the robot hand by installing an axis, which is kinematically redundant, in a hand of an existing six-axis articulated robot, improving productivity by reducing a cycle of an assembling process by smoothly performing and simplifying a component assembling work and a component transferring work, and effectively solving problems of the deformation of the components and damage to the components due to gripping power or a change in a component gripping position due to an external force after gripping the components by including a means capable of controlling the gripping power of the grippers when gripping the components.
source_title: A robot hand for holding power control assembly including a possible gripper

abstract: The human hand-imitating robot hand mechanism consists of one palm, five fingers and mechanical interface, and the mechanism interface set in the root of the palm is for the connection between the human hand-imitating robot hand mechanism and robot arm. Of the human hand-imitating robot hand mechanism, each of the thumb and the index finger has one freedom and is driven with one motor; the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger have one common freedom, are driven with one same motor and are designed in the same module with the only difference in far knuckle length; and the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger have their front two knuckles motion coupled separately. At the joint shaft between each near knuckle and the palm, there is motion decoupler, and when the near knuckle contacts some object, the other knuckles may move further to complete the wrapping and clamping on object.
source_title: Humanoid manipulator mechanism

abstract: The invention provides a visual servo and multi-task control method for a flying mechanical arm based on a spherical model. According to the method, an adopted servo structure comprises a drone, a mechanical arm and a control module, wherein the mechanical arm is mounted on the mechanical arm mounting surface of the drone, a depth camera is further arranged on the mechanical arm mounting surface,the shooting angle of the depth camera and the mechanical arm mounting surface form an angle, the control module enables the depth camera and the mechanical arm to be combined into a robot hand-eye calibration system, an actuator is arranged at the tail end of the mechanical arm, the control module is a control module capable of controlling the flight of the drone, when the flying mechanical arm needs to operate the target, the control module evaluates the target distance through the depth camera, if the target is located outside the operation range of the mechanical arm, the control module drives the drone to fly towards the target, and if the target is located within the operation range of the mechanical arm, the control module drives the mechanical arm to operate the target. According to the method, the mechanical arm with active control capability can be mounted on the drone.
source_title: Visual servo and multi-task control method for flying mechanical arm based on spherical model

abstract: The invention provides a robot hand grabbing strategic planning method based on the environment attracting domain. The robot hand grabbing strategic planning method comprises the steps that model parameters of a robot hand and model parameters of workpieces to be grabbed are extracted according to the type of the robot hand and the structure of the workpieces to be grabbed; the state variables and the output variables of a constraint function with the environment attracting domain are selected based on the model parameters of the robot hand and the model parameters of the workpieces to be grabbed; the states value of the state variables are obtained based on the value range of the state variables, and the output values of the corresponding output variables are obtained according to the state values of the state variables; the environment attracting domain of the constraint function is determined based on the state value of the state variables and the output value of the output variables; the robot hand grabbing strategy is planned based on the environment attracting domain of the constraint function. The application range of the method is wide, and the method can be used for various robot hands with different structures and types and objects with different sizes to be grabbed. By means of the method, the grabbing strategy of the robot hand can be planned quickly and accurately. Sensors are not depended on, the grabbing stability is good, and the cost is low.
source_title: Robot hand grabbing strategic planning method based on environment attracting domain

abstract: A robot hand module includes a thumb module and a finger module each coupled to a palm part, wherein the thumb module or the finger module includes a phalangeal part movably coupled to the palm part and a cable part and a driving part each connected to the phalangeal part, wherein the driving part includes a driving part body extending in one direction and including a rotary shaft configured to rotate by receiving power, a drum member coupled to one side of the driving part body, connected to the rotary shaft, and having an outer periphery surrounded by the cable part, and a tensioner member spaced apart from the drum member in a direction in which the cable part extends outward, wherein the tensioner member is movable in the direction in which the cable part extends to adjust tension of the cable part.
source_title: Robot hand module

abstract: The robot hand axis (7) has several hand link components (10, 11, 12, 13, 14) which can turn relative to each other, an internal through guide (34) passing through them, a flexible supply hose (35, 36) inside the guide, and a hose drive (38, 39, 40) to turn the supply hose forcibly inside the guide in the same direction as the hand link components.
source_title: Robot wrist with hose drive for rotating a supply hose, and associated process

abstract: A robot hand (11) comprising two receiving portions (111, 112) for receiving, processing, and placing a workpiece (6) is provided. The robot hand (11) is configured to receive the workpiece (6) conveyed by a conveyor (4) at a lower side of the conveyor (4), process the workpiece (6), and place the processed workpiece (6) in a specified position (5).
source_title: Robot hand, robot system provided with the robot hand, method of production using the robot system and product produced by the method

abstract: A workpiece (1) is gripped by a robot hand (11) and the image of the workpiece (1) is captured by a camera (103) without being stopped. An image processing device (104) detects the position and posture of a characteristic portion (105) of the workpiece (1). A robot controller (102) stores the present position of the robot (101) once or more times synchronously with the output of an image pick-up trigger instruction. On the basis of the present position of the robot (101) and a detection result, the relative position and posture between a flange of the robot (101) and the workpiece characteristic portion (105) is detected. The relative position and posture is compared with that observed when the workpiece (1) is gripped correctly, to determine a gripping error. If the gripping error exceeds a permissible error, the robot (101) is stopped. If the gripping error is equal to or less than the permissible error, a taught position where the workpiece (1) is to be released is corrected so as to cancel the adverse effect of the gripping error. <IMAGE>
source_title: Workpiece conveying apparatus with visual sensor for checking the gripping state

abstract: PURPOSE: A hand protecting device of a robot is provided to protect the hand of the robot by transmitting the emergency signal to the control unit, stopping the operation of the robot hand, and placing the hand of the robot in the right position after releasing the emergency state. CONSTITUTION: A hand protecting device of a robot is composed of a base frame(100) having plural supports(130) and upper and lower plates(110,120), a buffer unit(200) combined with the upper plate of the base frame and composed of a plunger holder(210) embedding a first elastic member(230) and the end of a first plunger(220) in a line to buffer impact, a sensor unit combined with the buffer unit and composed of a switching unit for detecting collision of the hand of the robot, and a guide unit(400) displaced according to impact at a collision of the hand of the robot to switch the sensor unit.
source_title: Protection device for a robot hand

abstract: A gripping device which simulates the action of a human finger comprises three pivotted sections 3, 5, 7 having the middle section 5 linked to the top section 7 by a bar 9 so that its rotation causes rotation of the tip section. Rotation of the lower section 3 is preferentially effected by a motor 11 via a sliding cross-head 15, an equaliser bar 18 and a rod 19. If this rotation is stopped by an object 25 to be gripped, the drive transfers via rod 20, crank 21 and rod 23 to the middle section 5, causing the middle and tip sections to rotate and grip the object against the lower portion as shown at 26. A robotic hand comprising four such fingers and a thumb is usable as a substitute for a human hand in a glove-box glove.
source_title: Gripping device.

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a dexterous hand and a robotic.The dexterous hand comprises a palm base, a multi-connecting-rod mechanism, at least one connecting frame and at least one first finger assembly, the multi-connecting-rod mechanism is arranged on the palm base, and the first finger assemblies are correspondingly arranged on the connecting frames; the first finger assembly comprises a telescopic driving mechanism, a thumb assembly and a side swing assembly, the palm near end of the thumb assembly is rotatably connected with the side swing assembly around a first axis, the palm far end of the connecting frame is rotatably connected with the side swing assembly around a second axis, and the first axis and the second axis are spatially crossed. The connecting frame is arranged on the multi-connecting-rod mechanism, the telescopic driving mechanism is arranged on the connecting frame, lateral swinging of the thumb assembly can be achieved through cooperation of the telescopic driving mechanism and the lateral swinging assembly, then the dexterous hand with the multi-connecting-rod mechanism can achieve finger lateral swinging movement, the operation flexibility of the dexterous hand is improved, and the application range of the dexterous hand is widened.
source_title: Dexterous hand and robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot hand-eye systems, in particular to a visual guidance imaging device based on teleoperation. According to the technical scheme, the device comprises a fixing frame, a mechanical arm and a 3D camera device fixedly connected to the lower surface of the top of the fixing frame, and further comprises a motor box and a conveyor, the top of the motor box is rotationally connected with a vertical shaft, the inner side of the motor box is connected with a motor, and an output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with the bottom end of the vertical shaft; an upper cross arm and a lower cross arm are fixedly connected to the outer surface of the vertical shaft in the vertical direction, an upper tray is fixedly connected to the end, away from the vertical shaft, of the upper cross arm, and a reference workpiece is placed on the upper tray. Through the design of the upper cross arm, the upper tray, the reference workpiece and other structures, the device not only has the advantages of global view field, simple calibration and control, good anti-seismic performance, stable attitude estimation and the like in a fixed imaging eye watching system, but also solves the problem that a mechanical arm in the fixed imaging eye watching system shields an imaging view field.
source_title: Visual guidance imaging device based on teleoperation

abstract: The present invention relates to a robot system to draw a portrait with tools used for drawing by a person. According to the present invention, the robot system comprises: an image photographing device photographing a person or a character to generate image data; an image processing device detecting an edge part from the image data to generate edge data; a robot including a first rotation motor, a first robot arm coupled to the first rotation motor and rotating on the first rotation motor, a second rotation motor coupled to the other end of the first robot arm, a second robot arm coupling one end to the second rotation motor and rotating on the second rotation motor, a third rotation motor coupled to the other end of the third rotation motor, and a robot hand coupled to the third motor; and a robot control device acquiring coordinates of each edge of the edge data, calculating a rotational angle of the first and second rotation motors in accordance with the coordinates, controlling the first and second rotation motors based on the calculated rotational angle, and controlling the third motor to lift the robot hand in a region where drawing is not to be performed.
source_title: ROBOT SYSTEM FOR DRAWING PORTRAIT

abstract: A robot system (1) according to an aspect of an embodiment includes a robot (10), a determination unit (work determination unit) (21a), a selection unit (chucking direction selection unit) (21b), and an instruction unit (21c). The robot (10) has a robot hand (hand) (17) including three or more chuck jaws. The determination unit (21a) obtains information on a member formed including a substantially ring shape, and determines a state of the member. The selection unit (21b) selects whether to hold the member with the chuck jaws from an inner peripheral side or outer peripheral side based on the determination result of the determination unit (21a). The instruction unit (21c) instructs the robot (10) to perform operations of transporting the member while holding the member with the chuck jaws based on the selection result of the selection unit (21b), and assembling a predetermined processed product using the member.
source_title: ROBOT SYSTEM

abstract: A gas cylinder transfer apparatus and a gas cylinder logistics system including the same are disclosed. The gas cylinder transfer apparatus includes a transfer vehicle for transferring a gas cylinder and a transfer robot disposed on the transfer vehicle. The transfer robot includes a robot hand for supporting a lower surface portion of the gas cylinder and a hand drive unit for moving the robot hand in horizontal and vertical directions.
source_title: Gas cylinder transfer apparatus and gas cylinder logistics system including the same

abstract: The invention discloses an industrial robot hand-eye calibration error accurate detection method based on binocular vision. The method comprises the following steps that a conversion relation matrix of a binocular camera relative to the tail end of an industrial robot is obtained through an industrial robot hand-eye calibration method; a binocular camera is fixed to the tail end of the industrial robot, and the left and right cameras are used for shooting a general calibration board photo for calibration to obtain parameters of the left and right cameras; acquiring coordinates of two angular points of the universal calibration plate in a camera coordinate system by using a binocular camera; and the coordinates of the two angular points are converted into a base coordinate system of the industrial robot according to a hand-eye calibration result, the distance between the two angular points in the base coordinate system is calculated, and the distance is compared with the actual distance between the two angular points of the universal calibration plate to obtain a calculation error. According to the method based on the high-precision binocular vision, operation is convenient, material taking is convenient, calculation is simple, the hand-eye calibration error can be accurately measured to the millimeter level, and feasibility is achieved.
source_title: Industrial robot hand-eye calibration error accurate detection method based on binocular vision

abstract: PURPOSE: A sample-labeling and ejecting robot hand for cold rolled steel plates is provided to reduce duty cycle by sorting and storing labeled and no-labeled samples at the same time. CONSTITUTION: A sample extracting line in a cold-rolling process comprises a transfer line, an alignment unit, a label printer, a sample box, a scrap box, and a robot hand(110). Labeled samples and non-labeled samples are selectively received in the sample box and the scrap box. The robot hand is installed between the label printer, the sample box, and the scrap box to receive the samples in the sample and scrap boxes. The robot hand comprises a frame(112) with a connector(111), a labeler(113) which attaches labels to the samples on one side of the frame, and a sample sucker(114) which receives the sample in the sample or scrap box.
source_title: SAMPLE LABEL ATTACHMENT

abstract: A robot hand device which can control the finger-tip force with high precision by using a force sensor of relatively small rated measurement, and can perform delicate grip operation by decreasing the outside diameter or the length of a finger-tip portion. A force sensor (12) is provided at the tip (3) of a finger which bends and stretches through a plurality of joints. The force sensor (12) is fixed between the proximal end (10) of the finger tip (3) and a joint (6) under inclining posture so that the main shaft (16) is directed toward a thickest part (11) of finger-tip formed between the distal end (9) of the finger tip (3) and the proximalend (10) of the finger tip (3) adjoining the joint (6). The extension axis (z) of the main shaft (16) of the force sensor (12) extends toward the thickest part (11) of finger-tip while passing between a first straight line (a) extending in the longitudinal direction of finger to pass the center of the finger tip (3) and a second straight line (b) extending to the bending and stretching direction side of finger while intersecting the first straight line (a) perpendicularly at the proximal end (10) of the finger tip (3).
source_title: ROBOT HAND DEVICE

abstract: The invention relates to a robot hand-eye calibration method and system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a rotation matrix from the tail end of a robot to a camera through controlling the robot to shoot a first calibration plate image group along a robot base coordinate system, and controlling the robot to rotate a preset angle clockwise and anticlockwise around a first rotation shaft, a second rotation shaft and a third rotation shaft, acquiring a second calibration plate image group on the corresponding robot poses, obtaining a first rotation translation relation between the calibration plate coordinate system and the robot base coordinate system, obtaining coordinates of the robot tail end in the calibration plate coordinate system according to the current position of the robot, and obtaining a calibration plate image group according to the sum of rotation translation matrixes from the calibration plate to the camera; the translation relation from the camera to the tail end of the robot is obtained, the calibration result of the eyes on the hand is obtained according to the rotation matrix from the tail end of the robot to the camera and the translation relation from the camera to the tail end of the robot, and the problems that a conventional hand-eye calibration method is not convergent in solving and low in accuracy rate are solved.
source_title: Robot hand-eye calibration method and system

abstract: PURPOSE: A device and a method for clamping a robot hand are provided to perform a finger gate calculation by using a supporting region and stability margin by selecting a finger to be moved and moving to a new gripping position, thereby easily gripping. CONSTITUTION: A method for clamping a robot hand comprises next steps. Each of rest fingers except for the moved finger among a plurality of the fingers of a robot hand gripping an object generates a candidate set including a state candidate in case of being separated from the object(S12). A supporting region of the state candidate is calculated(S14). The finger to be moved is selected among the rest fingers based on the supporting region(S16). The selected finger is moved to a target position direction(S18). The supporting region is the region calculated by being reflected on a 2D plane so that a region of an object center of the gravity maintains a static balance. [Reference numerals] (AA) Start; (BB) Finish; (S10) Reach to a target position; (S12) Setting a candidate set; (S14) Calculating a supporting area; (S16) Selecting a finger to move and moving the finger; (S18) Does each selected finger respectively move to a target position direction once?
source_title: finger gait planning method of robotic hands and finger gait planning apparatus of robotic hands

abstract: The invention discloses a parallel-connection belt/wheel/connecting rod linear parallel gripping self-adaption finger device and belongs to the technical field of robot hands. The device comprises a base, motors, transmission mechanisms, first finger sections, second finger sections, near joint shafts, far joint shafts, multiple transmission components, multiple transmission wheels, first connecting rods, second connecting rods, third connecting rods, springs, convex block driving discs, limiting blocks and the like. By means of the device, the functions that robot fingers conduct linear parallel gripping and self-adaption gripping are achieved; the second finger sections can be subjected to linear translational motion to hold objects with the fingers, and the objects in different shapes and of different sizes can be wrapped; the device is large in gripping scope; the under-actuated mode is adopted; each motor is utilized for driving the corresponding two finger sections, and no complex sensing and controlling system is needed; and the device is compact in structure, small in size, low in manufacturing cost and maintenance cost and applicable to a robot hand.
source_title: Parallel-connection belt/wheel/connecting rod linear parallel gripping self-adaption finger device

abstract: A robotic system includes a tendon-driven finger and a control system. The system controls the finger via a force-based control law when a tension sensor is available, and via a position-based control law when a sensor is not available. Multiple tendons may each have a corresponding sensor. The system selectively injects a compliance value into the position-based control law when only some sensors are available. A control system includes a host machine and a non-transitory computer-readable medium having a control process, which is executed by the host machine to control the finger via the force- or position-based control law. A method for controlling the finger includes determining the availability of a tension sensor(s), and selectively controlling the finger, using the control system, via the force or position-based control law. The position control law allows the control system to resist disturbances while nominally maintaining the initial state of internal tendon tensions.
source_title: Robust operation of tendon-driven robot fingers using force and position-based control laws

abstract: An anthropometric multi-finger hand of robot is composed of palm, the first and the second knuckles of thumb and forefinger, and the first and the second joints of thumb and forefinger. The said palmand knuckles are hollow for installing joint and motor driver in them. Its advantages include fewer number of drivers, easy control small size, light weight and several actions.
source_title: Multi-finger hand simulating human device for robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a method and a device for monitoring and limiting the velocity of an industrial robot having an arm including a plurality of arm parts and a robot hand, which are movable relative each other about a plurality of joints, and the movements of the joints are driven by a plurality of motors. The method comprises repeatably: - determining a parameter related to the angular speed of the motor for each motor of a selected subgroup of motors of the robot, - determining whether or not one or more predefined criteria for allowed arm velocity are fulfilled based on the determined motor related parameters, wherein said criteria are defined with respect to maximum allowed angular speed of the motors of said subgroup of motors, and - reducing the speed of one or more of the motors of the subgroup in case any of the criteria is not fulfilled.
source_title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR MONITORING AND LIMITING THE VELOCITY OF AN INDUSTRIAL ROBOT

abstract: The robot hand joint based on piezoelectric driving comprises a hand shell, the lower end of the hand shell is connected with a piezoelectric rotating motor, a plurality of finger joint units are arranged on the hand shell, and piezoelectric linear motors are arranged in the finger joint units; a first piezoelectric ceramic, a first stator and a rotor are arranged in the piezoelectric rotating motor; the piezoelectric rotating motor excites the first stator to vibrate through the first piezoelectric ceramic, and the rotor is driven to rotate through contact friction between the first stator and the rotor so as to drive the robot hand to rotate. A second piezoelectric ceramic and a linear motion mechanism are arranged in the piezoelectric linear motor; the piezoelectric linear motor excites the coupled bending vibration mode through the second piezoelectric ceramic to generate friction force, and the friction force drives the linear motion mechanism to do linear motion so as to drive the finger joint units to complete corresponding actions. According to the invention, high-precision and quick-response hand action control can be provided while a compact structure is realized.
source_title: Robot hand joint based on piezoelectric driving

abstract: The invention relates to an abduction-adduction mechanism, in particular to the self-locking abduction-adduction mechanism for a thumb of a dexterous robot hand. In existing thumb mechanisms of the dexterous robot hand, the function of the movement of opposition of the human hand is difficult to realize. According to the mechanism, a gear-worm transmission mechanism is arranged on one side of a palm plate frame and is provided with a drive circuit board. A thumb supporting base is located on the other side of the palm plate frame. The palm plate frame is provided with an absolute position sensor. An output shaft of a motor is arranged coaxial with a worm and is connected to one end of the worm through a speed reducer. A worm gear shaft is arranged on the side, close to the palm plate frame, of the thumb supporting base, and a dexterous robot hand thumb mechanism is arranged on the side, away from the palm plate frame, of the thumb supporting base. The absolute position sensor comprises a potentiometer and a through circuit board, wherein the potentiometer is fixedly connected to the through circuit board. A control circuit is detachably connected to an auxiliary base. The self-locking abduction-adduction mechanism is used for controlling the movement of opposition of the dexterous robot hand thumb mechanism.
source_title: Self-locking abduction-adduction mechanism for thumb of dexterous robot hand

abstract: A robot hand flange has an attached part for receiving an auxiliary device, such as a measuring body, a sensor, an additional or auxiliary tool.
source_title: Flange for a robot hand with an extension for mounting an accessory

abstract: Disclosed herein is a method of controlling a robot hand similar to a hand of a human being such that the robot hand naturally and safely grasps an object. The robot hand, including fingers and a palm, is capable of naturally and safely grasping an object, by the tip of each finger performing impedance control while following the optimal path on a Cartesian coordinate system, although the robot hand cannot reach a position ideal to grasp the object due to sensor errors or shape information of the object to be grasped is not correctly recognized. Also, the robot hand is capable of stably grasping the object even when moving or manipulating the object.
source_title: Robot hand and method of controlling the same

abstract: This patent proposal document provides a complete robot hand control scheme using myoelectric intention estimation of the human being using the kernel Principal Component Analysis Algorithm (kPCA). The robot hand system includes a biometric EMG sensor system, a robot hand including with multiple fingers, a controller connected with the biometric EMG sensor system, and a robot hand. The controller acquires the biometric EMG signal by means of a biometric sensor system, estimates myoelectric motion intention by applying the kernel principal component analysis (kPCA) algorithm using a kernel function, and delivers a control command corresponding to the estimated motion intention of the user to the robot hand.
source_title: Method for estimating intention using unsupervised learning

abstract: A sensor tip (10) for use in a robotic hand has a three-dimensional compliant elastomeric body (12) with an outer boundary (22) having a circular base (24) and a convex surface (26) extending therefrom. Four strain transducers (14, 16, 18, and 20) produce electrical signals indicative of the strain at various positions near the boundary of the elastomeric body (12) resulting from forces exerted upon the sensor tip (10) by an object which the robotic hand is manipulating. The transducers (14, 16, 18, and 20) are positioned about the convex surface (26) so as to produce signals that may be decoupled to determine the normal and tangential forces and the applied torque. A signal amplifier (34) and computer (36) may be incorporated for the decoupling of the signals produced by the transducers (14, 16, 18, and 20) into the four components. The sensor tip can be produced at relatively low cost, requiring only low precision manufacturing processes.
source_title: Multiple-degree-of-freedom sensor tip for a robotic gripper

abstract: PURPOSE: A robot hand capable of taking out upper and lower glasses and method to use thereof are provided to reduce costs because an inverter for inverting a glass is not required. CONSTITUTION: A robot hand capable of taking out upper and lower glasses comprises upper and lower hands(100,200) and a hand frame(300). The upper hand is moved upward and under a glass and adsorbs the lower plane of the glass. The lower hand is moved downward and above the glass and adsorbs the upper plane of the glass. The hand frame supports the upper and lower hands.
source_title: A robot hand which is capable of taking out upper and lower surface in glass, and method of using the same

abstract: PURPOSE:To correct dislocation of any part to be loaded with respect to a loading member by placing a floating base upon a supporting base to be fitted at the tip of a robot hand, and by injecting compressed air. CONSTITUTION:A horizontal plate-shaped supporting base 2 is fitted at the tip of a robot hand 1, and a floating base 4 is placed on this supporting base 2 with possibility of floating, with a stopper 3 interposed. A compressed air injecting head 6 installed on this floating head 4 is connected with the supply source of compressed air through a hose 7. A parts loading mechanism 9 is fixed at the front of a seat 8, which is stretching upright from the rear end of said floating base 4. Further, a gripping nail 12 to grip the parts to be loaded is fitted at the bottom of a rotary shaft 11, which is protruding downward from the floating and supporting bases 4, 2 through the holes bored therein.
source_title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR LOADING INDUSTRIAL ROBOT WITH PARTS

abstract: A robot hand includes a contactless holding part that has a first air jet port that radially jets air from the center toward the outer circumference, the contactless holding part contactlessly holding a wafer through radial flowing of the air jetted from the first air jet port and generation of a negative pressure due to the air. The robot hand includes also an outer circumferential support part that has a second air jet port that is disposed to be oriented toward the center of the wafer held by the contactless holding part and jets air toward the outer circumferential edge of the wafer, the outer circumferential support part supporting the wafer without movement of the wafer by the air jetted from the second air jet port.
source_title: ROBOT HAND

abstract: The invention relates to a robot hand-eye calibration method and device, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a product. According to the method, the pose of a calibration plate in a tool coordinate system is directly obtained, and then the pose of a visual sensor in a robot base coordinate system is obtained according to a pose derivation formula. A plurality of parameters in the pose of the calibration plate in the tool coordinate system and a specific data acquisition pose are limited through the calibration plate clamp, solving of a coupling matrix can be avoided, and the translation amount and the rotation amount of the calibration plate in the pose of the tool coordinate system are solved respectively, so that the calibration precision is improved. And meanwhile, the problem of data acquisition pose planning is avoided, and the operation difficulty is reduced.
source_title: Robot hand-eye calibration method and device, electronic equipment, storage medium and product

SOLUTION: The moving orbit of a robot hand 16 when used to chamfer the glass sheet G is made as an orbit A through which the rotational center O1of the robot hand 16 is moved up and down along a straight line Q having connected the rotational center O1of the robot hand 16 with the rotational center O2of a chamfering wheel 30.

abstract: The present invention provides a robot digit unit forming a robot hand, and winding or unwinding a wire to perform a gripping motion. The robot digit unit comprises: a unit actuator part having an actuator connected to wind or unwind the wire; unit link parts having a base link fixated on the unit actuator part at a relative position, and an end link connected to the base link; a joint pulley part arranged on a joint to which each link of the unit link parts is connected, having a base pulley arranged on the end facing the end link of the base link, and wound continuously by the wire; and a joint elastic part arranged on the joint where each link of the unit link parts is connected, separated from the upper part of the joint pulley part having a preset elastic force. One end of the wire is connected to the actuator and the other end of the wire is connected to the base link after being wound on the joint pulley part arranged between the unit link parts.
source_title: ROBOT DIGIT UNIT

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a side swing mechanism, a dexterous hand and a robot, and solves the problems that the side swing motion of each finger of the dexterous hand needs to be driven by one side swing mechanism, so that the dexterous hand is complex in structure and large in size. The side swing mechanism comprises a driving assembly, a first connecting rod and a second connecting rod. The driving assembly is connected with the first knuckles and drives the first knuckles to rotate so as to achieve side swing of the first knuckles. The first knuckles drive the second knuckles to rotate through the first connecting rods, so that the second knuckles swing laterally; the first knuckles or the second knuckles drive the third knuckles to rotate through the second connecting rods, and lateral swing of the third knuckles is achieved. Therefore, the lateral swinging mechanism achieves lateral swinging of the multiple knuckles through one driving assembly, the complexity of the lateral swinging mechanism is reduced, the size of the lateral swinging mechanism is reduced, and therefore the size of the dexterous hand is reduced, and the size of the dexterous hand is closer to that of a human hand.
source_title: Side swing mechanism, dexterous hand and robot

abstract: In one aspect, provided is a robotic hand, comprising a plurality of robotic fingers; and a robotic palm, configured to operatively connect with the plurality of robotic fingers, wherein individual robotic finger comprises: a first phalanx; a second phalanx; and a first hydraulic actuator, configured to operatively connect the first phalanx with the second phalanx, wherein the first hydraulic actuator comprises a soft, bellows-type deformable body, such that when in operation, the first hydraulic actuator is switchable between at least a compression status and an extension status, in response to external force and/or hydraulic pressure applied thereto. Other example embodiments are described herein. In certain embodiments, the disclosure provides robotic hands and systems that showed high degrees of compliance, adaptability, and precise control for robotic applications and addressed the challenge of achieving robotic fine in-hand manipulation.
source_title: ROBOTIC HANDS AND ROBOTIC SYSTEMS COMPRISING THE SAME

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of machine vision, in particular to the field of machine vision, in particular to a robot hand-eye calibration method and device, computer equipment and a medium, and can solve the problem of low calibration precision of a determined posture relation caused by linear solving of hand-eye calibration to a certain extent. Determining a robot hand-eye calibration equation and an initial rotation matrix and an initial translation matrix of the hand-eye calibration equation; determining a target distance of the hand-eye calibration equation through the rotation distance and the translation distance, and if the target distance does not meet a convergence condition, determining an alternative rotation matrix and an alternative translation matrix based on a second-order cone programming model and a Kronecker product method; the target rotation matrix and the target translation matrix can be updated, and the preset error distance can be updated; according to the embodiment of the invention, based on the nonlinear iterative optimization of the second-order cone programming model, the rotation part and the translation part are optimized at the same time, and the posture relation conversion precision of robot hand-eye calibration is improved.
source_title: Robot hand-eye calibration method and device, computer equipment and medium

abstract: The invention discloses a functional grabbing synthesis method for a dexterous hand robot and a training method of a corresponding prediction model. The functional grabbing prediction method comprises the steps of obtaining two-dimensional image data of an object and obtaining three-dimensional asset data based on the two-dimensional image data; inputting the object point cloud data into a first feature extractor to obtain first point cloud feature data; performing preset template matching processing on the first point cloud feature data to obtain affordability partial data; performing initialization and functional capture optimization processing on the point cloud data by using a capture initialization strategy and a functional capture synthesis strategy to obtain capture configuration data; inputting the grabbed configuration data into a second feature extractor to obtain grabbed feature data; inputting the point cloud data into a third feature extractor to obtain second point cloud feature data; inputting the point cloud data and the second point cloud feature data into a fourth feature extractor to obtain third point cloud feature data; and based on the grabbed feature data and the third point cloud feature data, obtaining predicted grabbed configuration.
source_title: Functional grabbing synthesis method for dexterous hand robot and training method of corresponding prediction model

abstract: PURPOSE: A wafer transferring device is provided to prevent the contamination of a wafer by polishing the surface of a receiver in contact with a wafer. CONSTITUTION: A robot hand(11) grips a wafer(1). An arm(12) linearly moves and rotates a robot hand. A driving unit(13) transmits driving force for moving and rotating the arm and the robot hand. A receiver for receiving the wafer is formed on the upper side of the robot hand. The receiver is formed to minimize the contact area with the wafer.
source_title: APPARATUS FOR TRANSFERRING WAFER

abstract: A robot programming device capable of easily checking interference between a robot and peripheral equipment, by which the interference can be easily avoided automatically or manually. The programming device has: a simulation executing part which executes a simulation of motions of peripheral equipment and a robot hand based on a control signal; a signal setting part which sets the control signal for executing the simulation, with respect to a teaching point or a trajectory between the teaching points included in a predetermined robot operation program or a program template, the control signal being set as attribute data of each teaching point or each trajectory; a moving part which moves the robot to the teaching point or the trajectory; and a display setting part which determines as to whether the workpiece is displayed or hidden, with respect to the teaching point or the trajectory to which the robot is moved.
source_title: Offline robot programming device
